programme.desc: 宅博士的父親宅再佳在勇敢之城探索時失蹤，現場唯一留下的一副鬥獸棋，也在與反派的爭奪中被打散，並幻化成八隻棋獸，分散在勇敢之城各個大陸為了知道鬥獸棋中隱藏的秘密，從而找到宅再佳的下落，超人們踏上了收服鬥獸棋之旅隨著超人們的進一步調查，他們發現事情遠沒自己想的那麼簡單，一個更大的陰謀正逐步浮出水面

programme.desc: 講述四隻貓咪變身超級英雄，與黑喵組織熱血奮戰保衛地球和平的故事這四隻貓咪既可愛又聰明，兼具正義與勇敢的特質，是孩子們喜愛的英雄形象劇集以充滿童趣的冒險為核心，圍繞貓咪們的英勇戰鬥展開，既展現了團隊協作的力量，也傳遞了守護和平的正向價值觀，適合各年齡段少兒觀看

programme.title: 權聽你說4
programme.desc: 權聽你說是新加坡主持人權怡鳳與嘉賓的深度聊天實錄彙集青春軌跡時代故事勵志範本與八卦雜談既犀利又溫馨的權式訪談風格，以知性幽默的方式，為嘉賓熬出一碗碗心靈雞湯節目去到第四季，權怡鳳前往香港和台灣，通過搞笑溫馨的對話走進知名藝人們的內心世界，挖掘他們精彩的人生故事和經歷第四季嘉賓包括張智霖袁詠儀曾寶儀周興哲羅子溢王祖藍草蜢及林心如

兒童節目太空鼠一家
programme.desc: 太空鼠是一群粉紅色的像老鼠一樣的動物，有著長長的鼻子以及針織般的質感，看上去溫暖又可愛太空鼠用獨特的口哨聲進行交流，它們熱情善良聰明古怪，善於發明創造，對什麼事物都充滿好奇在星光閃爍的無垠太空中有一個藍色的小星球，那裡就是它們的家，離我們的世界並不遙遠在這個神奇的宇宙中，太空鼠還有很多朋友，雖然大家性格迥異，愛好也不盡相同，但好在總能互相幫助，所以一起經歷了很多有趣的事情！

programme.desc: 前途無量改編自小説錢途，由白宇王志飛董勇李乃文王宥鈞主演，是一部以現代職場為題材的電視劇該劇由多位實力派老劇骨出演，以生活化的劇情背景講述職場逆襲，內容精彩絕倫！故事講述林強（白宇飾）是聯眾銀行總行授信審批部的副總經理，他不願意為問題貸款簽字，因此得罪了上級領導，被貶到業績表現最差的龍源支行，與林強同期進入銀行的摯友鄭帥（王宥鈞 飾）也受到牽連，一起被降職龍源支行管理混亂不堪，林強以出眾的專業能力，迅速發現了龍源的問題所在，很快建立起了一支工作團隊，並協助支行的員工們爭取應有的利益林強的行動激怒行長郝偉（李洪濤飾），開始對他施加種種壓力林強陷入事業危機，別無選擇下進行反擊，他查明了貸款案的問題，並成功解決最終，林強不僅實現了職業理想，也為銀行行業重新確立了秩序和規則，維護銀行人的初衷，展現出一個逆襲的職場故事

programme.desc: 今日宜加油是一部職場題材電視劇，根據韓國漫畫高斯電子公司改編，由鄭愷陳鈺琪王鶴棣主演，故事講述高發電子公司中企劃三部曾是高發電子最風光的部門，近三年因不靠譜企劃地位一落千丈但部門眾人以各自方式演繹平凡奮鬥者的生活，李天然範思思吳意美白馬帥等，有夢想有執著，對部門有深厚感情他們面臨副董挑刺一部競爭，用努力化解危機，使三部重回巔峰，也在笑中帶淚的職場中成長，收穫愛情與友情

programme.title: 20262027西班牙甲組足球聯賽：貝迪斯 對 皇家馬德里
重生技 第二季
programme.desc: 隨著現代高科技的發展，文保工作者們面臨著一場科技賦能的全新體驗，他（她）們利用高科技，通過透視眼無影手進行文物修復，使文物保護不再是器物表面雕琢與修補，而是對文保工作者們自身理念視角和認知的轉型升級片中揭秘八種糟朽或受損嚴重的寶藏級文物修護，記錄文物醫生打開科技新視角，踏上化腐朽為神奇的旅程，在跨學科的碰撞中，技術與藝術相伴共生，萬年永存

programme.title: 斑頭雁歸來的季節
programme.desc: 本片將以長江源地班德湖的自然環境和斑頭雁繁殖季為背景，聚焦志願者的環保行動生活狀態，依託他們監測拍攝斑頭雁的行為，穿插鳥類棲息繁衍生存競爭的自然故事，展現人類與自然環境交互影響的情景故事，引發觀眾對人與自然關係這一永恆主題更多的思考

programme.title: 我要逆風去
programme.desc: 我要逆風去是一部都市情感與勵志職場劇，講述民族服飾品牌在電商經濟衝擊下復興的歷程自香港投行跳槽回內地投資公司發展的投資人徐斯（龔俊飾），結識了國牌服裝集團董事長獨生女江湖（鍾楚曦飾），二人因商業理念不同而互不對盤江湖父親的企業突然破產，江湖一夜之間由雲端跌落谷底而一直頗有事業野心的徐斯對江湖父親曾經一手打造的膠底鞋品牌騰嶽勢在必得，使得落魄的江湖決定不惜一切保住騰嶽經一番周旋較量，最終徐斯與江湖立下是否能夠復興騰嶽的存亡生死契

programme.title: 趨記茶餐廳
programme.desc: 一部以澳門茶餐廳為背景的輕鬆幽默連續劇，故事圍繞茶餐廳的日常營運展開，當中穿插生活熱話，搞笑得來又有共鳴，歡迎大家光臨！

programme.title: 走進水世界
programme.desc: 通過鏡頭，體驗水上以及水中獨特感受，展開環球之旅，挑戰各種極限，探索未知領域，目睹大自然的美妙

programme.desc: 우리 민족은 기록에 관해서는 대단한 저력을 지니고 있다. 유네스코에 세계문화유산으로 지정된 조선시대의 승정원일기가 그렇고 그 사초를 바탕으로 편찬한 조선왕조실록이 그렇다. 현대 의회 민주주의의 전당, 국회에도 이러한 기록에 있다. 국민의 대표기관인 국회의 의정활동을 낱낱이 기록하는 속기록이 바로 그것. 여의도 국회 30주년을 맞아 국회방송에서는 총 16부에 걸친 연작 다큐멘터리 다시보는 속기록연출 조정훈을 제작, 방송한다. 이 프로그램은 질곡의 대한민국 현대사를 국회 속기록이라는 프리즘을 통해 재조명하고, 우리에게 주는 질책과 교훈을 담아낼 계획이다.

大漢盛世
programme.desc: 鐵腕定江山，仁德治天下，開創大漢文景盛世氣象西元201年，布衣天子劉邦擊敗西楚霸王項羽，建立了大漢王朝為鞏固皇權，誅滅韓信英布等異姓功臣，並應對匈奴威脅呂后專權後朝政動盪，直至誅呂之亂，性情仁厚長期鎮守代地的劉恒被推立為帝，是為漢文帝文帝即位後，以仁政安民，推行輕徭薄賦與民休息，抑制功臣與諸侯勢力，整頓吏治，重用賢才，推動農業與法制改革，同時安撫邊疆抵禦匈奴在權力與親情間多有取捨，含淚處置親族以穩國本最終奠定文景之治基礎，使漢室走向長治久安

programme.title: 大盛魁
programme.desc: 電視連續劇大盛魁由創業興業歇業三部一百集構成，歷史跨度270年由三個獨立完整的故事構成講述了王相卿張傑史大學等三個赤手空拳創業的故事

programme.title: 步步驚心
programme.desc: 張曉的命運被一場車禍徹底改寫她看著失控的卡車將自己的靈魂撞出了軀體，而她沒有進醫院也沒有進天堂，卻是被撞進了清朝的宮廷中就像穿越小說裏寫的那樣，張曉的靈魂跨時間隧道，一個叫若曦的十六歲清朝女孩的體內重生一場震動歷史的九龍奪嫡正暗潮湧動權利的廝殺，愛情的灼燒，被無限放大的歷史舞臺上，若曦的命運無可避免的與眾位阿哥們交織在一起她知道自己不該捲入這場九王奪嫡爭鬥中，可心不由己，因為這裡有所愛的，也有愛她的若曦最後選擇的是溫潤如玉的八阿哥，還是面冷心熱的四阿哥，又或是出人意料的其他人？

programme.title: 紫釵奇緣新

programme.title: 善德女王
programme.desc: 利用美色掌握宮中權力的美室，一心想成為王后，雖然摩耶王后在她的詭計下死裡逃生，還身懷六甲回到宮中，但摩耶王后懷的雙胞胎卻成就不幸的宿命，因為王室流傳一個預言御出雙生，聖骨男盡，意指王室若生出雙胞胎，將使王室男性斷了精氣真平王深知要是王后生下雙胞胎的事實曝光，一家人將會有無止盡的災難，於是命宮女昭火偷偷將其中一個女兒帶出王宮多年後被拋棄的公主德曼回到新羅，與雙胞胎姐姐天明公主同心協力對抗美室美室企圖用各種手段羅織罪名於德曼公主和天明公主，天明公主於一場追捕德曼的陰謀計畫下意外身亡，原本只想逃出新羅的德曼公主因為天明公主的死開始藉著聰慧的頭腦與身旁各方勢力的協助，最終擊垮政敵美室，成為第一個登上新羅王位的女性

programme.desc: 張曉的命運被一場車禍徹底改寫她看著失控的卡車將自己的靈魂撞出了軀體，而她沒有進醫院也沒有進天堂，卻是被撞進了清朝的宮廷中就像穿越小說裏寫的那樣，張曉的靈魂跨時間隧道，一個叫若曦的十六歲清朝女孩的體內重生一場震動歷史的九龍奪嫡正暗潮湧動權利的廝殺，愛情的灼燒，被無限放大的歷史舞臺上，若曦的命運無可避免的與眾位阿哥們交織在一起她知道自己不該捲入這場九王奪嫡爭鬥中，可心不由己，因為這裡有所愛的，也有愛她的若曦最後選擇的是溫潤如玉的八阿哥，還是面冷心熱的四阿哥，又或是出人意料的其他人？

programme.title: 大漢盛世首
programme.desc: 鐵腕定江山，仁德治天下，開創大漢文景盛世氣象西元201年，布衣天子劉邦擊敗西楚霸王項羽，建立了大漢王朝為鞏固皇權，誅滅韓信英布等異姓功臣，並應對匈奴威脅呂后專權後朝政動盪，直至誅呂之亂，性情仁厚長期鎮守代地的劉恒被推立為帝，是為漢文帝文帝即位後，以仁政安民，推行輕徭薄賦與民休息，抑制功臣與諸侯勢力，整頓吏治，重用賢才，推動農業與法制改革，同時安撫邊疆抵禦匈奴在權力與親情間多有取捨，含淚處置親族以穩國本最終奠定文景之治基礎，使漢室走向長治久安

programme.title: 大盛魁
programme.desc: 電視連續劇大盛魁由創業興業歇業三部一百集構成，歷史跨度270年由三個獨立完整的故事構成講述了王相卿張傑史大學等三個赤手空拳創業的故事

programme.title: 步步驚心
programme.desc: 張曉的命運被一場車禍徹底改寫她看著失控的卡車將自己的靈魂撞出了軀體，而她沒有進醫院也沒有進天堂，卻是被撞進了清朝的宮廷中就像穿越小說裏寫的那樣，張曉的靈魂跨時間隧道，一個叫若曦的十六歲清朝女孩的體內重生一場震動歷史的九龍奪嫡正暗潮湧動權利的廝殺，愛情的灼燒，被無限放大的歷史舞臺上，若曦的命運無可避免的與眾位阿哥們交織在一起她知道自己不該捲入這場九王奪嫡爭鬥中，可心不由己，因為這裡有所愛的，也有愛她的若曦最後選擇的是溫潤如玉的八阿哥，還是面冷心熱的四阿哥，又或是出人意料的其他人？

programme.title: 龍虎門
programme.desc: 由王小虎王小龍和石黑龍三個熱血青年所創立的龍虎門武館，因一次誤取犯罪組織羅剎教權杖，成為眾惡霸的追擊目標，繼而展開一幕幕驚天動地的正邪對決改編自香港知名漫畫家黃玉郎作品

programme.title: 父子武狀元
programme.desc: 公安鞏偉瞞著妻兒混入犯罪集團臥底，並為辦案需要丟下病重的妻子和兒子小固，到香港經悍匪小黑介紹而獲黑道大哥賞識香港女督察方逸華前往北京調查鞏偉的身份，與鞏固漸生感情，在其母病逝後帶小固赴港尋父然警方卻以小固為餌欲引出鞏偉，鞏偉因而與方逸華交戰小固則被小黑救走，卻又被犯罪集團挾持，鞏偉和方逸華雙雙前往營救，與匪徒爆發一場激鬥

programme.title: 嚦咕嚦咕新年財
programme.desc: 德華和天樂是一對兄弟，以打牌為生的德華出名好牌技好牌品，與他相戀多年的詠琪因牌品差而始終未能結為連理，便詛咒他從此一世摸爛牌結果詛咒靈驗了，德華將所有財產輸給了青雲，但一向樂觀的他深信自己的好朋友終會回歸後來在天樂公司舉行的麻將大賽中一路過關斬將，與青雲再次對壘

programme.title: 新天龍八部之天山童姥
programme.desc: 巫行雲與李秋水互爭天山童姥之位，為了春秋所乘，幸在最後關頭，阿紫棄暗投明，與虛竹協助巫李兩人，卒能誅殺元凶，重建天山之祥和

programme.title: 大顯神威
programme.desc: 保坪宮第十八代師公王富貴（豬哥亮飾），人稱豬哥仙，實際上逢賭必輸，輸到攜家帶眷南下投靠有錢妹婿（黃明志飾），不料妹婿中風，王富貴因緣際會認識保坪宮第十八代繼承人龍老大（李李仁飾），還誤打誤撞遇見了美豔女鬼晴霞（安心亞飾），從此時來運轉，但請鬼拿藥單，總要付出代價的原來，晴霞30年前曾經是紅透半邊天的歌姬，卻為愛香消玉殞，含冤遊蕩在陰陽兩界這次找上豬哥仙，要他大顯神威，解開塵封多年的謎底

programme.title: 鬼們之蝴蝶大廈新
programme.desc: 為了逃離施暴的丈夫，陳薇帶著女兒搬進一棟頻繁發生墜樓自殺事件的老舊公寓蝴蝶大廈，管理員與住在頂樓的老廟公多次警告：有一層樓，千萬不要靠近陳薇逐漸察覺周遭異常，而那戶緊閉的613號房，更如黑洞般吞噬著她的神經，唯一帶來片刻安寧的，是時常上門關心陳薇母女的代理管理員小梁隨著農曆鬼月到來，蝴蝶大廈逐步陷入一場無形的詭異風暴

programme.title: 寒單
programme.desc: 正月十五，炮炸寒單爺現場擠滿了人潮，肉身寒單阿義站在神轎上，威風凜凜地接受信徒丟上鞭炮轟炸忽然間，成堆的炸藥被引爆，意外造成阿義女友萱萱的死亡；不忍心看保住性命卻喪失一切的阿義墮落社會邊緣，正昆毅然放棄成為教師的機會，用盡力氣將阿義拉離地獄的深淵歃血為盟的兄弟二人，一同經營昆儀回收場，怎知當年意外的真相曝光後，兩人從此在情義的天平兩端生死掙扎，炸在身上的紋身之罪，是否能抵消深藏的錐心之痛？

programme.title: 鎖命危機
programme.desc: 平凡獨居女子京敏，某天下班回家，發現房門的電子密碼鎖，蓋子竟被陌生人打開！她隨即變更密碼，卻在當天晚上睡前，赫然聽到有人試圖要打開她的密碼鎖被恐懼感包圍的她，縱使向警察報案，但警察對如此程度的案件並沒有予以理會之後，京敏的套房再度出現被闖空門的跡象，甚至伴隨一起離奇的殺人案

programme.title: 最強囍事
programme.desc: 頂級美容師沈美廣受女性觀眾歡迎，高薪擔任石油大王夫人Dream化妝品公司總監，與王牌銷售員鄭宇強原欲合力對付公司裡一班難纏女同事，反變相替她們解決了各自的心理問題與感情煩惱但二人面對自己的感情問題卻束手無策，宇強忘不了初戀女友美玲，在美玲婚禮當天，用心為美玲化了一個美麗的新娘妝，送自己最愛的女人出嫁

programme.title: 縱橫四海
programme.desc: 三個相依為命的孤兒，在慧眼獨具的養父刻意培養下，成了國際通緝的頂尖大盜只是三人已厭倦了不能行走在陽光下的生活，而與養父約定了最後一次的任務，不料，祖（周潤發飾）卻在這次任務中葬身火海數年後，結為連理的占（張國榮飾）和紅豆（鍾楚紅飾）與祖歡喜重逢，就在三個人過著他們嚮往的太平生活時，養父突然出現，打破風雨前的寧靜

programme.title: 特務迷城
programme.desc: 夢想成為特務的小北（成龍飾），從小習武且有一點預知能力，憑著特長幫忙逮捕了銀行搶匪，不料因此開啟尋親與繼承遺產之旅然而，這一切竟然與美國政府失竊的炭疽菌有關！？

programme.title: 恐怖攻擊直播
programme.desc: 一位剛被降職而轉為主持廣播節目的主播尹榮華，某天接到不知名聽眾callin，恐嚇要脅若不回答問題或是掛電話，他將炸掉大橋，原以為只是無聊民眾的玩笑，沒想到就在掛掉電話後，他就親眼看見辦公大樓旁的跨海大橋遭到炸毀，該起恐怖攻擊造成無數傷亡！尹榮華意識到極可能是最近的連環爆炸事件主謀所為，於是緊急和電視台協議獨家直播該起爆炸案，企圖藉機讓自己重拾主播工作但接下來的直播過程卻漸漸開始失控

programme.title: 一八九五
programme.desc: 甲午戰爭清廷戰敗，同意將台灣割讓給日本1895年初夏，日本近衛軍團自台灣東北角登陸，準備接收台灣台灣士紳紛紛召募義勇軍積極備戰美麗的黃賢妹（楊謹華飾）曾遭土匪擄去，平安歸來後卻沒人相信她的清白秀才吳湯興（溫昇豪飾）不顧流言依約迎娶，信任與愛令黃賢妹銘感在心為了抗日，吳湯興投筆從戎，組成了客家義民軍，率領客家男丁為保家衛國而奮戰，黃賢妹則與全村女眷共同染衣耕作，作為他的強力後盾

programme.title: 正宗絕代雙驕
programme.desc: 移花宮主（張敏）新任武林至尊，誓要殺盡十大惡人，而與丈夫燕南天反目燕雖退敵但慘變植物人，惡人李大咀及屠嬌嬌遂將燕之子撫育成人，改名小魚兒（劉德華），宮主則收養女嬰花無缺（林青霞）培植她做接班人十八年後，小魚兒與花無缺在賞善罰惡大會上相遇，展開糾纏的命運

programme.title: 開心鬼
programme.desc: 一名多次赴考未中狀元的古人，懸樑自盡後附於麻繩上，而意外來到八十年代，遇上一群女學生成為好友，也因此鬧出許多笑話

programme.title: 臨時劫案
programme.desc: 兩個頹廢中年難兄難弟慕容輝笠水計劃搶劫，卻意外遇到真正悍匪梅藍天，陰差陽錯間三人臨時組隊打劫贓款，不料錢款早已被捷足先登，一時間匪徒各懷鬼胎，互相吞併，與此同時女警探姜姐也將三人鎖定，槍戰搶錢一觸即發，臨時劫案誰生誰死誰破案

programme.title: 賭俠大戰拉斯維加斯
programme.desc: KING與化骨龍成為老千拍檔，加上化骨龍的表哥阿叻，三人合力在大惡人大眼文的地下賭場騙了一大筆錢，準備去風流快活，不料大眼文派人追殺，在海邊酒店擄走化骨龍KING及阿叻被警方邀往拉斯維加斯協助辦案，欲捉拿大老千Peter朱KING使用奇謀妙計，不但順利將Peter朱帶回香港，並起回四十億贓款！

programme.title: 邊防戰區
programme.desc: 一名駐紮在阿富汗的年輕荷蘭士兵，其隸屬車隊在戰區遭到炸彈攻擊，他朝一名阿富汗嫌犯開槍，但是他萬萬沒想到，這件事很快就引發了一連串的危機，並讓這場炸彈攻擊的倖存者留下了一道無法抹滅的陰影

programme.title: 午夜密令
programme.desc: 1939年夏天，一間位在英國南部海岸專收納粹高官女兒的奧古斯塔維多利亞女子學院，嚴格遵循著希特勒的納粹思想英籍校長羅喬爾僱用英籍教師湯瑪斯米勒作為臨時教師；湯瑪斯並在校長與其他德籍教師們的監視下，教導這群女孩練習英語這時，校園中出現一位前任教師的屍體，也讓湯瑪斯陷入致命危機

programme.title: 玩命快遞：肆意橫行
programme.desc: 法蘭克馬丁卸下特務身分後，轉行成為地表最強送貨員，他的客戶通常是身分可疑的危險人物，不過他從不過問交易細節拿錢辦事而且絕對使命必達當退休的特工老爸來到南法找他時，原以為可以再續父子天倫之樂，沒想到老爸卻涉入蛇蠍美女安娜與其美麗同夥策劃的銀行搶案，法蘭克必須用他非凡身手與飛車絕技，救回最珍貴的家人！

programme.title: 我的老爸喵星人
programme.desc: 老爸不是人，變成喵星人！商業大亨湯姆狂熱於工作事業而疏忽家庭關係當得知女兒蕾貝卡11歲生日最想獲得的禮物是一隻貓，湯姆便來到寵物店挑選，但回程途中發生意外，湯姆竟被困在貓的身體裡，並由自己的女兒蕾貝卡收養湯姆開始體驗到除了財富之外，人生的另一種價值

programme.title: 北極戰隊
programme.desc: 北極狐史威帝在北極物流公司的收發室工作，但他有著遠大的夢想：希望有朝一日能成為頂尖的北極快遞員為了證明自己的能耐，史威帝自告奮勇運送一批神秘貨物，卻意外發現海象奧托的邪惡計畫，他與手下們打算釋放地底下的古代氣體，讓北極完全融化史威帝與他的好友們組成一支臨時戰隊，要阻止奧托的可怕陰謀！

programme.title: 催眠狙擊
programme.desc: 剛復職的警探丹尼洛克在調查一宗銀行搶案的過程中，發現一名具有強大催眠能力的危險男子，竟和自己日前離奇失蹤的女兒有關在催眠師黛安娜協助下，他嘗試追查並拆解箇中謎團，反而讓他們被該男子追殺而身陷險境，事情發展出人意料，顛覆他對身邊一切的認知

programme.title: 狂人法則
programme.desc: 川普瘋狂事蹟全揭露，川普法律團隊揚言提告的爭議之作！年輕的川普為了擺脫房地產大亨父親所帶來的陰影，立志要在曼哈頓房地產業界闖出名聲因緣際會之下，他結識了惡名昭彰的律師羅依科恩科恩看中川普的潛力，教導他邁向成功的狂人法則兩人透過無所不用其極的瘋狂行事，成功讓川普的房地產事業崛起

programme.title: 迴路追殺令
programme.desc: 退休特種部隊軍官羅伊，某天早上起床後，突然慘遭刺客屠殺，下一秒卻又回到床上，接著醒了過來，展開新的一天這時他才發現，自己被困在一個永無止盡的時間循環當中，有時被射殺有時被炸彈攻擊，甚至被斬首或刺殺他必須扭轉一些事情，才能挽救前妻，並揭穿邪惡軍事科學家的陰謀

programme.title: 叛諜檔案
programme.desc: 前任美國中情局CIA成員韋爾本可享受退休後的清閒時光，卻被嫁禍於一樁國外記者謀殺案件中脫不了身能力高超的他，在美國成為各國眼中釘的情況下，被迫回歸CIA，只為了釐清嫌疑，殊不知此舉讓他深陷更危險的陰謀當中

programme.title: 地獄娃娃
programme.desc: 一名古董學家受邀至蘇格蘭鑑定具有300年歷史價值的發條娃娃，古堡地處偏僻人煙罕至，當地居民因其恐怖傳說而稱她為地獄公主，在研究過程中，錯亂的既視感讓他陷入恐怖詛咒的糾纏

programme.title: 摔角王：風雲再起
programme.desc: 他已故的父親身兼東加王國男爵與知名摔角冠軍兩大頭銜，在返鄉處理遺產時竟捲入黑白兩道衝突，他必須為了奪回父親被盜的冠軍腰帶而奮鬥！

programme.title: 跟著IKEA衣櫥去旅行
programme.desc: 阿賈是來自孟買的街頭魔術師，當他的母親過世後，他決定前往巴黎尋找他未曾謀面的生父阿賈抵達巴黎，卻窮到只能躲進IKEA的衣櫥中過夜，沒想到竟連人帶衣櫥被送往了英國，還被警方當成非法移民遭逢致命的危險，後又輾轉到了義大利羅馬跟女明星奈莉有了難解之緣，阿賈還冒險登上熱氣球飛越地中海沒想到一段超展開的意外旅程幾個萍水相逢的異國人，最後卻幫助他找到了真正的自己

programme.title: 騙局
programme.desc: 安端羅卡是一位家族企業的老闆，因經營不善而申請破產，但無意中得知公司未用罄的碳排放量配額可以變現！這讓他想出了一個點子：成立空殼公司透過稅法漏洞進行碳排放量配額買賣，進而賺取消費稅差額這個歪主意雖然讓他大筆進帳，並順利買回破產的公司，卻也為他和周遭的好友們引來一連串殺身之禍

programme.title: 水星任務
programme.desc: 突然從天而降的大量金屬碎片引發民眾恐慌，經檢驗後發現是來自水星的磁化殘骸；同時一名科學家收到正在執行水星任務的妻子突然失聯的消息，心急如焚的他自製接收器，意外收到來自妻子發出的訊號，整合所有資訊後竟發現，地球將在18小時內與水星相撞！

programme.title: 時空交戰
programme.desc: 二位上古神明和敵人對戰時，意外在時空漩渦中墜落，發現自己身處當今世界只有一名年輕女孩，據說她的眼睛可以看清一切並擁有強大的力量，只有她才能送他們回自己的時空以拯救諸神人類還有動物；否則所有生命皆將逝去

programme.title: 神鬼二勢力
programme.desc: 兩位出沒於墨西哥的辣妹俠盜以銀行為目標，劫富濟貧頻頻得手，成為家喻戶曉的傳奇而她們真正的敵人，其實是已將魔爪漸漸深入小鎮的邪惡勢力！

programme.title: 小麻煩當家
programme.desc: 嬌生慣養養尊處優的狗狗小麻煩從小過著皇帝般的幸福生活不料女主人突然過世，牠被迫流落街頭，忍受風吹雨打日曬雨淋；某天牠意外找到了一位新主人：一位立志當歌手的年輕女孩，人狗之間一拍即合，從此相依為命，一同面對各種逆境，朝夢想邁進！

programme.title: 瞞天機密
programme.desc: 在英國情報機構任職的中文翻譯員凱薩琳，某天收到一封讓她備感震驚的電子郵件，內容顯示美國國安局為使聯合國安理會同意發動伊拉克戰爭，竟串通英國政府執行非法行動，企圖改變聯合國表決結果凱薩琳向媒體揭發此事，成功引發世界輿論的關注與譴責在此同時，她也因為違反國家機密法而遭控叛國罪她該如何對抗這個不公不義的政府？而這個世界又將如何回應她的勇氣呢？

programme.title: 36總局
programme.desc: 巴黎街頭出現一群窮凶惡極的匪徒，犯下多起血腥暴力的攻擊事件，警方卻遲遲抓不到兇手警界盛傳只要將這幫惡人緝拿歸案，就能接替巴黎刑警局局長之大位而警局裡最有勝算的兩大警探，里奧為求破案不惜包庇線人，卻意外捲入謀殺案；丹尼則因過於服從上級，導致隊友因公殉職激烈的爭權鬥勢，讓他們兩人迷失在道德邊界，這場權力戰爭將何去何從？

programme.title: 極地追擊
programme.desc: 美國懷俄明州印第安自治區，偏僻荒涼，律法難以管控，許多謀殺案件層出不窮獵人柯瑞（傑瑞米雷納飾）和FBI探員珍（伊莉莎白歐森飾）共同調查一宗當地少女謀殺案，兩種完全不同的文化背景和社會形態，漸漸走入充滿人性掙扎的迷霧當中，隨著複雜脈絡的揭開，兇案真相也逐漸顯現

programme.title: 荒野大鏢客
programme.desc: 位處美墨邊境荒涼的墨西哥小鎮，來了一位總是叼著根雪茄煙槍法神準的大鏢客鎮上有巴特幫洛荷幫兩大幫派，專門販賣私械私酒，兩幫長期廝殺，魚肉鎮民，弄得鎮民們是妻離子散，家破人亡出於正義，大鏢客運用計謀讓雙方展開火拚，最終將小鎮的惡勢力全數消滅

programme.title: 赤狐書生
programme.desc: 清貧書生王子進赴京趕考途中，遇見下凡取丹的小狐妖白十三白十三為了晉升狐仙，假意陪王子進趕考，實則要讓王子進主動獻出丹前往京城的路途遙遠又充滿危險，一人一狐相互扶持共患難，成了莫逆之交歷盡萬險，終於到了白十三在友情與成仙之間作出抉擇的時刻

programme.title: 時光機器
programme.desc: 19世紀的英國發明家喬治搭著自己發明的時光機器前往未來，期盼未來會是和平世界，但實際上卻戰爭不斷當他來到最遙遠的未來，發現此時只剩下生活在地面的艾諾伊族，與生活在地底並以艾諾伊族為食的莫勒克族喬治挺身帶領艾諾伊族反抗，並協助他們重新建立文明

programme.title: 香米小情歌
programme.desc: 年輕貌美的美國科學家琳達被公司派往印度銷售她所培育的9號稻米初次來到印度的琳達飽受文化衝擊，遇到一位因為繳不出學費而輟學的大學生羅傑，兩人卻在研究與爭執過程當中陷入熱戀，羅傑也幫她發現被派往印度的醜陋內幕，原來她想要幫助印度農民的研究成果，竟不知不覺地被無良公司濫用，即將對農民造成毀滅性的傷害！琳達該要如何阻止這場災難？而她與羅傑的異國戀又將會開花結果嗎？

programme.title: 英雄訣57-58完
programme.desc: 英雄訣57-58完

programme.title: 異域2：孤軍
programme.desc: 泰北孤軍奉國民政府命南撤至緬甸泰國寮國邊境後，開始在燥濕的環境下，自行開闢村落生活有人四處流竄變成土匪，有人則跟當地政府妥協

programme.title: 御前夜巡使
programme.desc: 相傳幾百年前，妖邪橫行襲擾宮廷，戍衞王城的夜巡使一職應運而生，名為夜巡實為捉妖！而後天下昇平日久，多年無妖可捉的夜巡使日漸衰敗，初出茅廬的少年燕離可謂血脈僅存然而，突發的連環血案，再次戳破王城夜幕的寧靜十幾名皇室宗親和大臣慘遭屠戮，而始作俑者卻隱藏於迷霧重重的夜幕之中在不斷反轉的正反較量與愛恨糾結中，主人公燕離的命運車輪也隨之開始轉動

programme.title: 太空英雌
programme.desc: 41世紀時，性感單純的宇宙情報員芭芭麗娜，奉宇宙愛之聯盟首相的請託，前往鯨魚座的崇光國尋找失蹤科學家杜蘭杜蘭太空船在抵達時受到磁力干擾而墜毀，芭芭麗娜被一群野孩子所擄獲，幸得一名賞金獵人搭救並幫忙修復太空船，唯一需付出的代價是性愛彼時地球人早已用高科技心靈交流來取代這原始行為，但為報答獵人芭芭麗娜只得應許，卻因此感受到前所未有的愉悅

programme.desc: 李祘1-2

programme.title: 偷龍轉鳳
programme.desc: 妮可是巴黎著名的邦尼家族千金，但邦尼家族私下係以偽造名家藝術贗品為樂巴黎一所博物館將舉行藝術品展覽，妮可的父親受邀參加，然而其中被視為偉大傑作的維納斯雕像，其實是她祖父製造的贗品，投保一百萬美元不料，保險公司要求技術鑑定，眼看事蹟即將敗露，妮可只得聘請一位高明神偷賽門偷走雕像

programme.title: 黃飛鴻
programme.desc: 黃飛鴻李連杰飾常教人練武可自強救國，但見政府苟且，洋人橫行，民間私鬥，漸覺武術不可解國困沙河市黑幫到戲班收取保護費，衍生連串風波戲班開鑼日，鴻被人追殺，死傷無數提督大怒，要查封寶芝林及逮捕鴻，鴻答允救治傷者後投案沙河幫並將十三姨關之琳飾擄走，鴻與寬合力救出十三姨，寬亦拜鴻為師，從此隨鴻學藝

programme.title: 江湖女間諜
programme.desc: 來自愛爾蘭的瑪麗亞一號，從小隨著革命家父親為反對英國統治而四處進行破壞一次行動中父親不幸喪命，她誤打誤撞躲藏在馬戲團，遇到法國來的瑪麗亞二號為了幫她逃避英軍追捕，兩個瑪麗亞結成表演組合，因大膽表演迅速爆紅一次表演後，瑪麗亞二號邂逅了革命首腦弗洛雷斯並為其偉大情操打動，但弗洛雷斯卻不幸被獨裁者追捕射殺，瑪麗亞二號便繼承其遺志，號召村民展開抗爭，瑪麗亞一號也憑多年經驗來幫助平民百姓

programme.title: 追男仔
programme.desc: 單親爸爸程勝獨力撫養三個女兒長大成人，假稱患上絕症對女兒們催婚精英女警與男公關善良社工與古惑仔醫生與純情少爺，三對冤家笑料百出，是否能修成正果呢？

programme.title: 大進擊
programme.desc: 二戰期間，英國轟炸中隊於巴黎上空執行轟炸任務，其中一架轟炸機被德軍擊中，飛行員被迫跳傘逃生，並約好在清真寺旁的土耳其浴室會合其中三名英軍分別降落在動物園水池歌劇院，以及正在重新粉刷的納粹祕密警察總部屋頂，在動物園管理員歌劇院樂團指揮與油漆工幫助下逃生而樂團指揮和油漆工，更陰錯陽差隨著三名英軍飛行員，與德軍展開了一場場驚險刺激的逃亡之旅！

programme.title: 赤腳小子首
programme.desc: 赤腳青年關豐曜進城投靠父親好友，卻意外捲入地方勢力爭鬥，最終為求出人頭地而付出慘痛代價與惡霸決一死戰

programme.title: 紅色高跟鞋雙語版
programme.desc: 狠心母拋家嫁富豪 棄子重生 只為揭穿母親真面目一段因愛與慾望而撕裂的親情，點燃了跨越二十年的復仇烈火年輕時的熙瓊為追逐榮華，狠心拋夫棄子，投入舊情人赫相懷抱，卻一步步被權力與野心吞噬她的女兒珍瑪在父親離世母親棄養的陰影下成長，懷著深深怨恨潛入熙瓊身邊，以設計師與繼孫女的身分逐步揭穿母親的虛偽面具母女之間愛恨交織，真相與謊言親情與仇恨輪番交鋒，最終將迎來一場足以摧毀一切的命運對決

programme.title: 魔女之城雙語版
programme.desc: 婆媳小姑撕破臉！命運抓弄下的同居奇蹟一場毀滅性的家庭變故，讓原本關係緊繃的離婚婆婆媳婦與小姑，命運交織地被迫同住在一個屋簷下撕下以往的對立標籤，三個性格迥異傷痕累累的女人在滿是摩擦與衝突的日常中，漸漸看清彼此的脆弱她們相互扶持攜手抵禦人生的逆境風浪，最終走出陰霾，共築出比血緣更堅固的暖心情誼！

programme.title: 小歡喜
programme.desc: 望子成龍！ 都會家庭的高考大作戰 以三個家庭為主軸，方圓和童文潔一家三口，他們的兒子方一凡即將面臨高考，但父母的壓力與兒子的無憂形成鮮明對比，使得家庭關係逐漸緊張另一方面，單親媽媽宋倩與女兒喬英子的生活也充滿了挑戰，前夫的糾纏和女兒的叛逆讓她左右為難最後，季楊楊從小被寄養在舅舅家，父母突然的關懷讓他陷入矛盾，父親季勝利努力與他建立親子關係，但結果並不理想這些家庭的故事交織在一起，展現了現代都市生活中家庭親情和成長的種種困境和溫暖時刻

programme.title: 木蘭復仇記首
programme.desc: 家破人亡張天愛女扮男裝！逆襲成女元帥盛國公之女阿麥目睹至親慘遭滅門，女扮男裝隱姓埋名，從貧民窟設局保命到混入軍營浴血奮戰！她憑藉絕妙陣法與過人膽識，在硝煙中一戰成名，從柔弱孤女蛻變為令敵軍聞風喪膽的鎮北軍元帥面對深陷權謀的帝王情愛宿敵常鈺青的真心追求，阿麥看破情鎖，毅然拒入後宮，率領軍民駐守靖陽劃地獨立，霸氣活出不靠男人的大女主傳奇！

programme.title: 小歡喜
programme.desc: 望子成龍！ 都會家庭的高考大作戰 以三個家庭為主軸，方圓和童文潔一家三口，他們的兒子方一凡即將面臨高考，但父母的壓力與兒子的無憂形成鮮明對比，使得家庭關係逐漸緊張另一方面，單親媽媽宋倩與女兒喬英子的生活也充滿了挑戰，前夫的糾纏和女兒的叛逆讓她左右為難最後，季楊楊從小被寄養在舅舅家，父母突然的關懷讓他陷入矛盾，父親季勝利努力與他建立親子關係，但結果並不理想這些家庭的故事交織在一起，展現了現代都市生活中家庭親情和成長的種種困境和溫暖時刻

programme.title: 被告人
programme.desc: 話題冠軍韓劇，正義檢察官池晟孤軍奮戰尋找真凶！！最強正義檢察官朴政宇，被冤枉殺害妻女入獄及事件發生後失去了記憶，成為了被告人為了洗刷背負的嫌疑罪名而不得不在獄中拼湊記憶與找出殺害妻女的真凶，這時他也進入人生最糟糕的兩難選擇，陷入檢察官的鬥爭中

programme.title: 紅色高跟鞋雙語版
programme.desc: 狠心母拋家嫁富豪 棄子重生 只為揭穿母親真面目一段因愛與慾望而撕裂的親情，點燃了跨越二十年的復仇烈火年輕時的熙瓊為追逐榮華，狠心拋夫棄子，投入舊情人赫相懷抱，卻一步步被權力與野心吞噬她的女兒珍瑪在父親離世母親棄養的陰影下成長，懷著深深怨恨潛入熙瓊身邊，以設計師與繼孫女的身分逐步揭穿母親的虛偽面具母女之間愛恨交織，真相與謊言親情與仇恨輪番交鋒，最終將迎來一場足以摧毀一切的命運對決

programme.title: 魔女之城雙語版
programme.desc: 婆媳小姑撕破臉！命運抓弄下的同居奇蹟一場毀滅性的家庭變故，讓原本關係緊繃的離婚婆婆媳婦與小姑，命運交織地被迫同住在一個屋簷下撕下以往的對立標籤，三個性格迥異傷痕累累的女人在滿是摩擦與衝突的日常中，漸漸看清彼此的脆弱她們相互扶持攜手抵禦人生的逆境風浪，最終走出陰霾，共築出比血緣更堅固的暖心情誼！

programme.title: 殘酷的實習生
programme.desc: 羅美蘭化身高年級實習生 道盡女性職場家庭壓力曾叱吒職場的女強人高海羅，在為家庭中斷事業七年後，決心重返職場找回自我價，從主管跌回實習生，她不僅要面對年齡與職場現實的殘酷挑戰，更得直面昔日競爭對手如今成為上司的崔智媛在一項充滿道德兩難的任務中，海羅被迫於同為母親的立場與職涯機會之間掙扎劇情深刻刻畫中年女性在家庭工作與自我之間的拉扯與重生，以真實而細膩的情感，引發無數職場女性共鳴

programme.title: 寵妻明君：李祘
programme.desc: 年幼的李祘目睹了父親死於政治陰謀，又在祖父近乎慘酷的調教下長大，雖然貴為王位繼承人，但政敵始終欲治李祘於死地，這些練就了李祘逆境中處變不驚不折不撓的品性宮廷畫苑的畫師韓松淵是李祘的紅粉知己後來松淵做了李祘的王妃，一直堅定地支持着李祘的治國大業

programme.title: 女王之家
programme.desc: 心機渣男出軌妻子閨蜜 為奪下豪門不擇手段！人人稱羨的模範夫妻申明燮與韓善珠，在紀念婚禮當天揭開了幸福假象出身豪門的善珠外表完美，內心卻藏著被背叛的恐懼；出身貧寒的明燮，靠婚姻翻轉人生卻陷入外遇泥沼而第三者尹美羅，不僅成為他的靈魂寄託，更在命運的捉弄下與善珠結為好友當真相逐步揭開，愛與恨正宮與小三的界線逐漸模糊，一場婚禮，也預告了一場悲劇的開始

programme.title: 當你沉睡時
programme.desc: 擁有預知夢能力的洪珠，因總是只能夢見未來卻無力改變而讓她痛苦不是金湯匙出生也沒有優秀的學歷及人脈，卻總是富有充滿正義感的檢察官宰璨兩人的相遇為了阻止夢境的可怕事件變成現實，開始相信對方是否能成為扭轉未來的人呢?

programme.title: 兩個女人的房間
programme.desc: 慘遭閨蜜心機暗算 朴恩惠由飯店繼承人淪為女僕在瑞士留學歸來後，晴彩充滿自信地踏入了蒙娜麗莎飯店，端莊秀麗的外表和聰穎的頭腦，讓她很快成為了飯店的副社長兼繼承人與同飯店的總經理志燮之間的戀情，更是讓她的生活充滿了甜蜜和期待一場車禍意外將掀起腥風血雨，當晴彩以為自己撞死了熙秀的養父時，內心充滿了恐懼與內疚感，在晴彩的堅持下，熙秀搬進了她的家，開始了新的生活從那時起，晴彩心愛的人和她的一切都逐漸被熙秀所奪走，包括飯店的地位和財富，晴彩更是從繼承人淪為女僕，為了奪回曾經的一切，晴彩將對熙秀展開復仇

programme.desc: 慘遭閨蜜心機暗算 朴恩惠由飯店繼承人淪為女僕在瑞士留學歸來後，晴彩充滿自信地踏入了蒙娜麗莎飯店，端莊秀麗的外表和聰穎的頭腦，讓她很快成為了飯店的副社長兼繼承人與同飯店的總經理志燮之間的戀情，更是讓她的生活充滿了甜蜜和期待一場車禍意外將掀起腥風血雨，當晴彩以為自己撞死了熙秀的養父時，內心充滿了恐懼與內疚感，在晴彩的堅持下，熙秀搬進了她的家，開始了新的生活從那時起，晴彩心愛的人和她的一切都逐漸被熙秀所奪走，包括飯店的地位和財富，晴彩更是從繼承人淪為女僕，為了奪回曾經的一切，晴彩將對熙秀展開復仇

programme.title: 寵妻明君：李祘
programme.desc: 年幼的李祘目睹了父親死於政治陰謀，又在祖父近乎慘酷的調教下長大，雖然貴為王位繼承人，但政敵始終欲治李祘於死地，這些練就了李祘逆境中處變不驚不折不撓的品性宮廷畫苑的畫師韓松淵是李祘的紅粉知己後來松淵做了李祘的王妃，一直堅定地支持着李祘的治國大業

programme.title: 殘酷的實習生
programme.desc: 羅美蘭化身高年級實習生 道盡女性職場家庭壓力曾叱吒職場的女強人高海羅，在為家庭中斷事業七年後，決心重返職場找回自我價，從主管跌回實習生，她不僅要面對年齡與職場現實的殘酷挑戰，更得直面昔日競爭對手如今成為上司的崔智媛在一項充滿道德兩難的任務中，海羅被迫於同為母親的立場與職涯機會之間掙扎劇情深刻刻畫中年女性在家庭工作與自我之間的拉扯與重生，以真實而細膩的情感，引發無數職場女性共鳴

programme.title: 寵妻明君：李祘

programme.title: 女王之家
programme.desc: 心機渣男出軌妻子閨蜜 為奪下豪門不擇手段！人人稱羨的模範夫妻申明燮與韓善珠，在紀念婚禮當天揭開了幸福假象出身豪門的善珠外表完美，內心卻藏著被背叛的恐懼；出身貧寒的明燮，靠婚姻翻轉人生卻陷入外遇泥沼而第三者尹美羅，不僅成為他的靈魂寄託，更在命運的捉弄下與善珠結為好友當真相逐步揭開，愛與恨正宮與小三的界線逐漸模糊，一場婚禮，也預告了一場悲劇的開始

programme.desc: 一個腐敗的香港警察三哥林正英攜帶大批鑽石財寶去了日本投靠了黑幫稻草人俱樂部.瑞奇元彪和雞骨草成龍奉命追至日本緝拿,他們在地鐵發現了三哥,並且去追,追到遊樂場,三哥的接應人日本黑幫前來阻擋,三哥被走脫了,而瑞奇被黑幫一棍子打昏,抓了起來.雞骨草打了個電話,叫曹警司曹達華叫鷓鴣菜洪金寶前來日本幫忙.鷓鴣菜此時在香港監獄關着,曹警司叫手下監獄官田俊將他釋放,結果他才...

programme.title: 我左眼見到鬼粵
programme.desc: 何麗珠鄭秀文飾出身平凡,一次旅遊邂逅男子 Daniel,相識七日便閃電結婚,未及回港,Daniel 便意外溺斃.麗珠這才知道亡夫是有錢人,並意外繼承了大筆的遺產,但精神上極度空虛,終日沉溺煙酒.某夜,醉醺醺的麗珠駕着丈夫生前喜愛的古董車在寂靜的公路上撞車,麗珠的靈魂被撞飛出軀體,其小學同學王勁威的鬼魂劉青雲飾出現,逼她魂魄走回軀體內,麗珠大難不死後從此左眼見到鬼...自從...

programme.title: 喋血雙雄粵
programme.desc: 阿莊周潤發 飾是一個職業殺手,因為在工作時被發現而遭僱主解僱,然而開槍時的火光意外令年輕夜總會歌手珍妮失明葉蒨文 飾.為了幫助珍妮,阿莊籌了一大筆錢來替她做恢復視力的眼角膜移植.阿莊惹來一個警探李鷹李修賢 飾調查他的犯罪,最終兩人因緣際會地遇上.因為見到阿莊先前救過一名小女孩,再得知珍妮的手術後,李鷹明白到,逮捕這個殺手並不能達到正義.電影的高潮,是兩人與三合會在廢棄的教堂內...

programme.title: 飛鷹計劃粵

There are baked beans, magic beans and a loveable giant bean too! The journey is repeated with some special surprises along the way and everyone has a boogie when Dees friend finally succeeds in saying todays word!

programme.title: Ex-Static Messy
programme.desc: Messys fur is all spikey and everythings getting stuck together! Will a trip to OKIDOs Valley of the Lost Balloons reveal the answers?

programme.title: Rock A Bye Bo
programme.desc: Bo is tired and falls asleep in the middle of hunting for Fabios lost inflatable fruit. Its up to Mojo to finish the job - without waking up poor, exhausted Bo!

programme.title: Unicorse
programme.desc: Bluey cant get to sleep, so Mum reads her one last story. But they are interrupted by Unicorse, the most annoying hand puppet in the world, whom Bluey tries to reform.

programme.title: Mini Bluey
programme.desc: When Dad complains about how dissimilar Bluey and Bingo are, Bluey hatches a plan to make them more alike and happily introduces Mini-Bluey!

programme.title: The Love Badge
programme.desc: When Duggee gets a card from someone he loves, the Squirrels ask: does he still love them? In a show-stopping song, Delivery Chipmunk shows them the answer is a resounding YES.

programme.title: The Shopping Badge
programme.desc: Duggee loves to shop local, so the Big Shop is a Big Deal for him. Hes over-excited and wants two of everything. The Squirrels have to remind him we only popped in for milk!

programme.title: Im Hungry
programme.desc: King Tiger and the Jelly wonder what Duggee has planned for today. Tag wants a snack, Enid has a musical cheese chase, and Norrie has a haircut.

programme.title: Whats Hot?
programme.desc: Billy and the Sillies introduce a visit to chicken AE, the Squirrels build a bug house, Norrie has her chance to shine, and the Penguins give facts about whats hot and whats not.

programme.title: Go Jet Academy: Compass Navigators
programme.desc: Kyan and Foz are working on their compass navigation skills and need to find the North Tower within a magnificent maze in order to pass their academy test. Grandmaster Glitch also tries to join in the amazing maze action but ends up getting lost. In a fit of frustration, he glitches the maze by bulldozing through the hedges with his Grim-mower. The Grim-mower dives into the ground, causing the pathways to crack. Foz falls into one of the cracks and needs to be rescued.

programme.title: Mount Mumandad
programme.desc: Bingo and Bluey have five minutes to bed, just enough time to race to the summit of Mount Mumandad. But for them, facing powerful storms, avalanches and stinky spots will take teamwork.

programme.title: Dunny
programme.desc: Mum bans the girls from saying the word dunny because its not a word the Queen of England would use, but the kids try and trick her into saying it anyway.

programme.title: Pizza Girls
programme.desc: Bluey and Bingo make mud pizzas and deliver them to the grown-ups, but their pedal cars wheel keeps falling off.

programme.title: Driving
programme.desc: With only five minutes to play Driving, Bluey and Mum race against the clock to buy milk for a grumpy guest and have to escape an angry shopkeeper.

programme.title: Andy and the Hungry Dinosaurs
programme.desc: Andy and Jen are throwing themselves a party to celebrate an epic year on Dino Island but discover that their prehistoric pals have been helping themselves to all the party food.

programme.title: Boots
programme.desc: Bella and Lift visit Patch in the Cloud Kitchen, but he has lost one of his boots - it was stolen by a cheeky crab. This gives him a great idea for a tasty treat - crabby croissant.

programme.title: The Same Badge
programme.desc: As Peggee and the Hummingbirds journey up the river to deliver a parcel, they have fun spotting and avoiding the wildlife that they meet along the way. All while Otti tries to avoid playing with the boat whistle! The Hummingbirds see the likes of meerkats, an aye-aye and snapping turtles and soon bump into some friendly faces - Duggee and the Squirrels! They are delivering a parcel upstream too.

programme.title: The Delivery Badge
programme.desc: Chipmunk is cycling one day delivering his packages when he hits a rock and his trike falls apart! He has so many packages to deliver - what is he going to do now? Duggee offers to repair Delivery Chipmunks trike, but that will take too long. The packages need to be delivered right away or else! Duggee also has a delivery badge and he will try to deliver all of Chipmunks packages with the help of the Squirrels. Before they begin, they need to learn the rules of delivering. With some hard work,

programme.title: The Mirror and the Lichee
programme.desc: The curious title in this Huangmei Opera romance refers to the two props that signal a happy beginning between a scholar and a local beauty. The scholar polishes mirrors so as to be closer to his love, who signals her approval by tossing him some lichees. From that point on the course of their love becomes rocky, complete with murder and suicide.

programme.title: The Fastest Sword
programme.desc: Southern Swordsman Ting is named The Fastest Sword but is defeated by a street monk and has to fulfil his promise of working on stone craving with the monk for three years. Ting returns home to lead a peaceful life after that and declines all fight challenges. Even so, he is forced to fight the Northern Swordsman. Who will win finally?

programme.title: The Adventures of Emperor Chien Lung
programme.desc: Emperor Chien Lung travels incognito to Jiangnan to review his peoples livelihood but soon discovers that corrupt officials are oppressing his people. The emperor meets an upright young man and they join hands to teach the corrupt officials a lesson. The young man was appointed as his bodyguard thereafter.

programme.title: The Deadly Duo
programme.desc: The prince of the Sung Dynasty is captured by the Chin invaders and guarded by top martial arts masters. Two powerful patriots need to fight the overwhelming odds and pull off the impossible: to rescue the royal Prince and get out of the Chin stronghold alive.

programme.title: Sweet And Wild
programme.desc: Fang is a spunky young village girl who is not afraid to fight back against hooligans. She gets into trouble with the biggest hoodlum Tong when she foils his plans with a maid, causing Tong to plot a revenge. Luckily a man whom she is attracted to, Hai, comes in time to her rescue. Can they fight back?

programme.title: The Dragon Creek
programme.desc: This wuxia murder mystery film talks about a young girl whose father was ruthlessly murdered during Chinas early republican era. She has a list of villains who have been plotting against her father and together with her elder brother, the young girl sets out on a journey to hunt down the secret serial killer.

programme.title: The Mad Monk Strikes Again
programme.desc: The Living Buddha Ji Gong and the immortal Lu Dong Bin descend to the mortal world, where the fates of several women spark a rivalry. As the two deities showcase their powers in three bizarre contests, a series of hilarious mishaps unfolds. Amid romantic entanglements, an epic battle between immortals and mortals begins.

programme.title: Heads For Sale
programme.desc: Hua is an upright and brave swordswoman who will stand up against villains and do anything for Luo, the man she loves. When Luo is sent to jail by the corrupted police, she sets out to free him and did not hesitate to chop off two bodyguards heads. In the process, she also stumbles across an old enemy of her father who is back seeking revenge.

programme.title: The Dancing Millionairess
programme.desc: Peter was a key dancer in a dance troupe and applied to be the chauffeur of a rich girl, Betty. When he is rumoured to be her lover, Betty is furious and goes undercover as a reporter to investigate the rumour. They fall in love in the process, and after putting Peter through many tests, they finally seal their love with a dance.

programme.title: Rivals of Kung Fu
programme.desc: As Shen and Wong Fei Hungs relationship turns sour, Shen frames Wong and his disciple for murder. They are saved by a businessman Zhou, but Wong must win the Lion Dance Trophy to return Zhous favour. Can Wong Fei Hung defeat all skilled martial artists and complete his mission?

programme.title: House of Traps
programme.desc: An evil prince has hidden the stolen imperial treasures in a house filled with booby-trapped blades. Amid plasma-spurting attacks, heroes and rogues try to uncover the deadly secrets of the house...

programme.title: The Mighty One
programme.desc: Lung seeks five volumes of a renowned Kung Fu manual to gain invincibility. When he believes a martial arts school master possesses the volumes, he kills him and his daughter but leaves behind a young brother and sister. Years later, Lung loses two volumes and starts another bloody hunt but each attempt is interrupted by two mysterious warriors...

programme.title: Holy Flame of the Martial World
programme.desc: Yin Tian Chous parents were killed over a pair of flame-shaped blades. He and his sister were rescued, raised, and trained separately by a hero and a villain, each inheriting one of the blades. Sworn enemies at first, they eventually uncover their true identities and join forces to avenge their parents deaths.

programme.title: The Purple Shell
programme.desc: Hui and Ha are stuck in their unhappy marriages and are attracted to each other when they meet at a party. In one of their beach strolls, Ha picks up a purple shell and gives it to Hui as a memento. When Huis husband finds out about them, he hurts Hui and causes her to become seriously ill, while also blackmails Ha. How will this love story end?

programme.title: Shaolin Rescuers
programme.desc: Hong Xi Guan of Shaolin is chased and wounded by a martial arts scum who took refuge in the Qing court. He is saved and healed by friends from the wet market and they hide Hong in a bean curd shop to protect him. However, Hongs enemy finds him and ambushes him at the shop, hoping to capture Hong and all his friends.

programme.title: Princess Iron Fan
programme.desc: Tang San Zang and his disciples are halted by the Flaming Mountains, where only Princess Iron Fans fan can quench the fire. Refused help by the Bull Demon King and his wife, Sun Wukong must outwit them to obtain it. After crossing, they fall into a trap set by the White Bone Demon sisters, and Wukong must use his powers to save his master.

programme.title: Opium And The Kung-Fu Master
programme.desc: Tie Qiao San, head of the Ten Guangdong Tigers, is an honourable master with many disciples. As opium becomes popular among the nobles, Tie starts taking it and gradually harms his body. When an opium houses owner defeats Tie in a fight and he is only saved from being killed by his disciple, Tie vows to quit opium and get back on his feet.

programme.title: Diary of a Lady-killer
programme.desc: Tycoon Zhou is a playboy who is engaged to be married, but that did not keep him from working his charms on as many ladies as he can. He keeps a diary about his romantic escapades and soon, the women with whom he has been intimate with are being murdered one by one. Zhou becomes the number one suspect by the police but is the killer someone else?

programme.title: Brothers Five
programme.desc: The five Kao brothers, separated since birth, are unaware that the master of Teng Lung Manor has killed their father. All five however, vow to defeat the vicious gangsters at the manor due to their bullying ways. After reuniting and with much discipline and hard work, the Kaos are prepared to face Lung and his gang.

programme.title: Lovers Blades
programme.desc: The Lovers Blades, a pair of invincible weapons, are to be delivered to the Qing Emperor. However, they accidentally fell into the hands of Xiao Zhong Hui and Yuan Guan Nan, so Imperial Chief Zhuo Tian Xiong hunts them down for the blades. As the battle begins, the secret of the blades are also revealed.

programme.title: The Master Of Kung Fu
programme.desc: The famous kung fu master Wong Fei Hung teaches martial arts in Guangdong. A vicious gangster plots to harm Wongs disciples and frames him for robbery and murder. Wong has to fight against the culprit to prove his own innocence and take revenge for his disciples.

programme.title: Winner Takes All
programme.desc: Two private detectives want to gain fame by solving a series of robberies. However, they were fooled by the King of Thieves during the investigation. It was later discovered that all the robberies were related to a Japanese businessman, Miyamoto. Who is the real King of Thieves?

programme.title: Iceman
programme.desc: Falsely accused of murder, Ming Dynasty Imperial Guard Ying is pursued by his three sworn brothers until a fierce battle leaves all four entombed in ice. Four hundred years later, they awaken in modern Hong Kong, where they must reignite their ancient feud in a world they can barely recognise.

programme.title: My Darling Genie
programme.desc: A genie who is trapped in a Chinese oil umbrella helps an honorable young man and his uncle to deal with a covetous loan shark.

programme.title: Maybe Its Love
programme.desc: A girl Marble witnesses a murder case and reports it to the police. After much investigation, the police can only sort out the complicated relationships between a rich merchants mistress, a postman, a shop owner and his wife, but find no clue as to who the murderer is. Therefore, Marble decides to carry out her own investigation

programme.title: Flying Swords of Dragon Gate
programme.desc: This is a remake of the original 1966 classic, Dragon Gate Inn. The country is being policed by the East and West Bureaus, whilst the Emperors eunuchs have attained much power and control. With all the corruption, Zhao teams up with a group of assassins to systemically kill the eunuchs in order to save the country.

programme.title: Love in a Fallen City
programme.desc: Based on a novel of the same name by the famous novelist Eileen Chang and directed by the equally acclaimed director Ann Hui, this romance story depicts the challenging relationship between an introverted Shanghai divorcee and a cynical Malaysian playboy during the Japanese invasion of Hong Kong in the 1940s. Will the lovers be together in the end?

programme.title: Unbeatable
programme.desc: Former world champion boxer Fai meets fiery young fighter Qi in Macau. As he mentors Qi for an upcoming MMA tournament, Fai rekindles his passion for fighting, life, and the people he cares about.

programme.title: Doubles Cause Troubles
programme.desc: Two squabbling cousins find themselves in more trouble than they can imagine after their tenant ends up dead. The gangsters and the police are both after them, and they have no idea what they have done wrong!

programme.title: Fate Jealous Greed
programme.desc: The film consists of three short horror stories: a man tries to survive after he received a haunted mail predicting his death while a man mourns the death of his beloved wife, she becomes a ghost and tries to communicate with him three brothers clash over the care options of their elderly mother during dinner, leading to a terrifying murder.

programme.title: Nezha
programme.desc: A former top team racing driver wants to prove himself in a race but accidentally hurts his teammate Lily, leading to the teams downfall. When an inexperienced virtual car racing champion joins the team and unexpectedly shines in a real-life race, can the three drivers team up to regain glory for their team?

programme.title: Sex Beyond The Grave
programme.desc: During World War II, a singer was raped and killed by Master Tao during her escape, with all her valuables stolen as well. Since then, the Taos house became haunted. Years later, Master Taos descendant sells the house to a young couple to pay off a massive gambling debt, but the couple soon discover that it is haunted by the vengeful spirit...

programme.title: Mr Vampire
programme.desc: Taoist priest Kou is assigned to re-bury a rich man, in the hope that the new tomb will bring further prosperity. When the corpse turns into a vampire and wreaks havoc in the village, his disciples are also hurt by the vampire and possessed by a female ghost respectively. How can Kou save his disciples and hunt down the vampire at the same time?

programme.title: The Lost Bladesman
programme.desc: An epic historic adventure set during the turbulent times of the Three Kingdoms. Cao Cao attempts to enlist Guan Yu into his forces, but Guan is loyal to his sworn brother Liu Bei, who is also Caos enemy. As Guan tries to rescue Liu Beis concubine from Cao, he is forced to fight his way through. Can he succeed in the end?

programme.title: Ghost Wedding
programme.desc: Photographer Zhi Cheng is entangled with a woman in red, leading to the deaths of his relatives one by one. When the girl he likes, Si Tong, also dies mysteriously, Zhi Cheng vows to find out the truth but ends up revealing the secret of a ghost marriage...

programme.title: The Viral Factor
programme.desc: IDC agent Jon survives a mission where his entire team is betrayed by their superior, Sean, leaving him with a life-threatening injury. Travelling to Malaysia to find his long-lost brother, he is drawn into a kidnapping case, only to discover his brother is involved, and Sean is the mastermind behind it all.

programme.title: Fight Back to School
programme.desc: SDU officer Chow Sing Sing goes undercover at a school to locate a missing gun. With his partner Tat, he successfully recovers the weapon, only to stumble upon a munitions smuggling ring. In retaliation, the smugglers storm the school and take students hostage, forcing Sing to risk everything to save them.

programme.title: Kowloon Walled City
programme.desc: Neng was a street fighter in Northeast China but decides to start a new life in Hong Kongs Kowloon Walled City. Unfortunately, he is implicated in the fights and conspiracies among the triad forces. When his good friend is hunted down by the triad, Neng must team up with the residents of Kowloon Walled City to fight back and save his friend.

programme.title: Fist of Legend
programme.desc: Sent to Japan by his master, Chen Zhen rescues and falls in love with fellow student Hiroko Yamada, only to be drawn into the Black Dragon gangs conspiracy. As Chinese students disappear and Jing Wu Martial Arts School comes under attack, he joins Liang Shao Wen to destroy a secret lab, foil the conspiracy, and defend his nations honour.

programme.title: Look for a Star
programme.desc: Sam is a charismatic tycoon who has been divorced three times. When he meets Milan, a cabaret dancer and croupier, they immediately fall in love. However, their romance faces challenges when he proposes a prenuptial agreement, putting their budding relationship at risk.

programme.title: Girl with the Diamond Slipper
programme.desc: An aspiring TV actress gets into hot water when a stolen diamond is hidden in the shoes she bought for a party.

programme.title: Confession of Pain
programme.desc: Inspector Lau plans the murder of his father-in-law and shifts the suspicion away. When his wife grows suspicious, she hires his close friend, private investigator Bong, to uncover the truth. As the plot unravels, Lau escalates his schemes to silence all threats, leading to a deadly showdown between former friends.

programme.desc: Sports Scene brings you closer to all the action from all corners of the world, with highlights from across Europe, North America and Chinas top sports leagues. We examine the changes and growth in Chinas domestic leagues, as the country undergoes an incredible economic transformation. Our exclusive features, Tackling China, CBA Stories, and Beyond the Baseline, take you behind the scenes and closer to the top athletes in China, by providing a unique perspective on the top sports stories

It also makes use of trending topics online, while focusing on whats relevant in China and the world.

programme.desc: When Gran announces its time to choose a new Thunder Sisters Queen, Ugga assumes shes got it in the bag. But after a series of challenges the Thunder Games, it becomes clear Gran might not be ready to step down.

programme.title: Shock and Awww
programme.desc: Guy is always surprising Eep with romantic gestures and Eep wants to return the favor. But when Guy proves impossible to surprise, Eep has to step up her game.

programme.title: Straycation Part I
programme.desc: The Crood and Betterman parents have been struggling to get along theyre so different! The two couple realize they need some time apart and decide to get away from the farm and each other. Too bad both couples choose to take a break on the same, small beach.

programme.title: Yeti Superstitious
programme.desc: Right before basketball tryouts, Peng learns from NaiNai that it is his big bad year on the zodiac calendar which means bad luck. Peng is skeptical at first, but after seeing the positive effects of adhering to NaiNais superstitions, he dives headfirst into learning all he can to secure his spot on the team. Eventually, he becomes so consumed that he breaks up with Yi and Jin because of their zodiac incompatibility. Cut from tryouts, Peng eventually realizes with the help of his friends t

programme.title: Toad-al Recall
programme.desc: A wish-granting toad drops into Yi and the crews life just as the dumpling shop is being reviewed by a food magazine writer. Overwhelmed by her efforts to help her mom and NaiNai in the shop, Yi asks the toad to spit up helpful items but Jin and Peng arent so selfless. As a result of granting an abundance of wishes for the whole crew, the toad becomes too weak to continue. Realizing the error of their ways and why the toad appeared in the first place, Yi and Everest use their magic to revers

programme.title: Friday The 13Th
programme.desc: While Pod 4 cleans the cafeteria after school as punishment for causing a ruckus in class, Liam shares the legend of Crazy Eddy Meyer, a former janitor who went insane and lurks the halls at Cosmos High every Friday the 13th. Skeptical at first, the podmates bravado begins to erode when they find themselves locked inside the school on a stormy Friday the 13th. The group splits to traverse the spooky terrain of the empty school looking for an exit, as their escalating fear of Crazy Eddy is playe

programme.title: Bossmans Blues
programme.desc: Although it looks like a class treasure hunt, its really all about cooperation. To push this point, Mr. Towes appoints Liam to lead the group. Problem is, everyone has their own idea of how to succeed.

programme.title: Birchs Beef
programme.desc: Raffis admission of vegetarianism has Birch immediately jumping on the flesh-free diet bandwagon. Eventually she gives into temptation sinking her teeth into a burger as Sandra clicks her photo that becomes the winning entry in a burger chains Teen of the Month contest. In an effort to hold Raffis attention, Birch tries in vain to suppress her hypocrisy and the fast food advertising that expose her meat-eating ways.

programme.title: A Fine Balance
programme.desc: A falling out between Raffi and Liam puts Birch in an awkward position. Fed up with the impact the boys fight is having on her life, she recruits Sandra to help her give them a dose of their own medicine. Meanwhile Sandra is busy doing her own recruiting, looking for volunteers who wouldnt mine laying down on the job to help her win the Citywide Skateboard Jumpathon.

programme.title: Olivia And The Crystal Ball
programme.desc: While Olivia and her brothers play fortune teller, baby William accidentally breaks Dads new bowling trophy, When a friendly police officer shows up at the door selling raffle tickets, Olivia is convinced that hes come for William, and she devises a scheme to keep William safe from the arms of the law.

programme.title: Olivia Packs Up
programme.desc: Tired of having to share with her brother Ian, Olivia sets out on a trip around theblock in search of a place free from little brothers. She imagines herself crossing a vast desert by camel which isnt all its cracked up to be and eventually decides that having a little brother might not be so bad after all.

programme.title: Olivia And Grandmas Visit
programme.desc: Grandma is coming to visit, and Olivia couldnt be more excited. Shes less excited, however, about having to give up her bedroom and bunk with Ian. But when Grandma invites Olivia to share her room for a sleepover, Olivia finds out that rooming with her snoring grandmother isnt as much fun as she thought!

programme.title: Olivia Is Invited To Dinner
programme.desc: Olivia is thrilled to be invited to Francines for dinner, until she learns that she must reciprocate with an invitation. She worries that Francine will be unimpressed by her familys casual table manners. But after dinner at Francines proves not to be much fun, Olivia appreciates her own lively family dinners.

programme.title: Catch that Drone The Fairy of the Teeth
programme.desc: When Harpers drone flies away its up to the Dew Drops to get it back. And while Eden wishes she could fly like a drone, she learns that she can do great things with or without wings. When Dylan loses his first tooth the Dew Drops learn that the Tooth Fairy will be coming and Athena tries so hard to make a good impression that she almost ruins Dylans first lost tooth experience.

programme.title: Lost and Found In the Park In the Dark
programme.desc: The Community Centers Lost and Found is full and its up to the gang to use their detective skills and return the lost items to their original owners. Rodney only needs one more bird on his birdwatching list, but the only problem is that it only comes out at night! Team Zenko must help Rodney face his fear of the dark so he can get the last picture for his collection.

programme.title: Longest Yardwork The Girl Who Cried Goose
programme.desc: Donna plans a garden party for Rona, but the only problem is that her garden is overgrown and neglected. The team try to transform this jungle into a backyard just in time for the party. Lula finds an angry goose on the loose, and Team Zenko need to get it out of the park before soccer camp starts.

programme.title: Bands On The Run Vote For Casper
programme.desc: Bands on the Run Casper and Jimmy form a rock band to compete in the Deedstown Battle of the Bands. Vote for Casper Mantha is angling to win the office of Class Rep, but Kibosh fancies having a fellow ghost in power.

programme.title: Permission ImpossibleWhat Possessed You
programme.desc: Permission Impossible When Ras parents refuse to let him go on the school camping trip, he sneaks away and gets lost in the Scary Woods with Casper and Mantha. What Possessed You? When a lesson in taking possession of a human body goes awry, Caspers human ends up taking possession of him!

programme.title: The Yarn Fairy Bake It Til You Make It
programme.desc: When the trees start losing their leaves, Phoebe begins knitting the trees in the park sweaters, but when the neighborhood kids see the sweaters they think theyre a mysterious Yarn Fairy, and they want to see her in action, making it much harder for the Dews to put more sweaters on the latest trees that have lost their leaves. When Marcus and Harper team-up for a school project, they decide to bake something Its like inventing, but with food!, only to come across multiple baking missha

programme.title: Things That Go Bump Hide Like a Dew Drop
programme.desc: When something starts snatching things and causing havoc in Marcus house, Phoebe and the Dew Drops investigate only to find that its a stray kitten that they need to catch and find a home for before Marcus returns home. But in the end, Marcus decides to take the kitty in, as his own. Lola isnt very good at Hide Seek so the Dew Drops help her improve her game. But she becomes so good that no one can find her! And now shes going to be late to her own surprise tea party!

programme.title: Message in a Bubble Glitteretti
programme.desc: Kelp has a new trick with his bubbles: he can have his friends put voice messages inside that you hear when you pop them. But when Pixie decides she doesnt want the others to hear whats in her bubble, the chase is on to rescue it! Juniper is devastated when the traditional ceremony to celebrate her next level of spark achievement cant happen. Kelp helps introduce a new tradition.

programme.title: Talent Show Sad Sad Plant
programme.desc: Kelp writes a song about him and Scallop to perform at the unicorn show. But when it comes time, Scallop wants to keep the song just for them, leaving Kelp to come up with anew act- and fast! The kids all visit the magical musical plant greenhouse on Unicorn Land. They each pick a plant to take care of, and for Kelp its a sad, almost dead plant that he falls in love with.

programme.title: Dog the Right Thing
programme.desc: In preparation for the big race to determine the next Race Cadets, Sam Whippet challenges the Not Yet Cadets to build their own cars. The catch? The car parts are scattered throughout Pawston. The Not Yet Cadets compete in the final race to see which team will join the Race Cadets.

programme.title: All Paws on Deck Bonestand and Deliver
programme.desc: Tag wants to do something special for her Mom and Paws anniversary, so she recreates the boat cruise where her parents first met. Tag discovers that nothing is planned for Pawstons 100th birthday, so she decides the town needs to rebuild the old Bonestand for a big Pawston concert.

programme.title: Heavy Metal
programme.desc: The Rescue Riders get stuck in a cave with their rival, Magnus, during a race to find a new source of an important mineral.

programme.title: Iced Out
programme.desc: Frustrated that shes not fitting in with the team, Aggro goes off on her own with Elbone on a mission to save a dragon egg trapped in ice.

programme.title: Fire Marshal Melman
programme.desc: On Junior Marshals Day at the fire station, Melman gets stuck in a firetruck on its way to a real emergency. With Alexs help, Melman must overcome his fear of heights to help save a stuck cat, and learn that even heroes get scared sometimes.

programme.title: Fancy Fifths
programme.desc: When Marty accidentally steals a pair of slippers from a department store, he plans an elaborate heist to return them and learns in the end that its easier to own up to your mistakes than to cover them up.

programme.title: Big Poppy Neighbor War
programme.desc: When a troll starts to ruin the fun of open mic night Poppy is forced to enter a compliment battle.Branch tries to drive Sky Toronto away when he moves next door.

programme.title: Remote Out of Control Critter Comfort
programme.desc: Biggie takes Branchs superpowered remote but must return it before Branch finds outWhen Poppy builds a new home for a group of cute critters she accidentally attracts their predators.

programme.title: One Last Job
programme.desc: The team plans a heist in order to obtain the enchanted pendant that can lead them to the storm wheels. Elsewhere, Klaus and Veruca shipwreck on a mysterious island that is actually home to the mages, and also the Tianshang weapon helmet.

programme.title: Doom and Groom
programme.desc: Po and the team have one last attempt to get the pendant, but they will have to disrupt Jayeshs wedding, and contend with his guards, to do so. At the mage island, Klaus and Veruca get hold of the Tianshang helmet.

programme.title: The Pinging
programme.desc: Mr. Ping is possessed by the ghost of Master Mastodon, the ancient master sworn to protect the Tianshang storm wheels. After a ghostly sewer chase, Mastodon agrees to help our team to stop Klaus and Veruca. He reveals that their next step is to go across the sea to Central America.

programme.title: Ga Ba Goo Ba Ga The Babblist
programme.desc: Theres a new babblist in town- someone who claims to understand baby talk. Boss Baby spots this fraud right awayand must debunk his tactics before he scams the playgroup parents. MeanwhileTim tries to sell magazines with Boss Babys help.

programme.title: The Coo Chi Coup
programme.desc: Boss Baby loves awards- and the Golden Rattle trophy is no exception. When presented with the chance to win an award at a company retreathe must choose between his pride and his team.

programme.title: Lights, Camera, Org Chart!
programme.desc: Boss Baby creates an org chart to cement his leadership as the Boss of the playgroup babies. However when Bubbeezee photographer Travis Le Duque chooses anyone but Boss for his coverspreadthe status quo is upended! Tim continues to fail his class assignment: a model solar system

programme.title: End of the Dragon Master
programme.desc: Po, the kids, and the new Panda Guardians must work together to defeat Jindiao once and for all, and get a visit from an unlikely source

programme.title: Journey to the East
programme.desc: Feeling a little bored with their new hero life, Po and the kids are excited to accept an important invitation to the Forbidden City. Meanwhile, theres a curious disturbance deep in Panda Village...

programme.title: LMNs - LMNs - Sabotaje
programme.desc: Chip es un nio de 9 aos que prefiere jugar con sus compaeros antes de las clases de fsica y qumica con su maestra Susan. Un da, durante una visita escolar al Instituto de Alta Energa, un cientfico loco, el Dr. No, est realizando un experimento con una lente capaz de convertir materia en antimateria, lo que provoca un accidente y un rayo incontrolado que lanza a Chip y al cientfico a la dimensin del micromundo. Chip se da cuenta de que el accidente lo ha enviado a un lugar desconocido y no sabe cmo regresar. Unos tomos de hierro, mercurio e hidrgeno, representados como Fer, Merc e Hidro, lo guiarn para ayudarlo a encontrar el camino de vuelta. Al mismo tiempo, el Dr. No descubre que, debido al accidente, ha logrado crear antimateria, y el poder que esto le otorga lo prepara para convertirse en el amo del mundo.

programme.title: LMNs - LMNs - La corriente electrica
programme.desc: Fer, Merc e Hidro llevan a Chip a la Ciudad Atmica, donde hay noticias de otro humano, el Dr. No, que ha llegado al micromundo. Chip piensa que tal vez el Dr. No podra ayudarlo a regresar a su dimensin, y va a verlo para devolverle la lente que el cientfico perdi durante el viaje al micromundo. Pero el Dr. No est construyendo la Torre Negra, una poderosa mquina que lo ayudar a esclavizar a todos los tomos del micromundo. Ahora tiene muchos trabajando bajo sus rdenes, y los lanza contra Chip y sus amigos para convertirlos en prisioneros y arrebatarles la lente. Al escapar, Chip cae en una corriente elctrica que lo transporta muy lejos.

programme.title: 百味人生Bittersweet Destiny
programme.desc: 百味人生是一部以料理为引线，交织情感人性与台湾文化的原创戏剧故事围绕一位总舖师因为一宗陷害事件，使其女儿与五位徒弟从分崩离析到彼此纠葛，呈现横跨25年的恩怨情仇与家族纠结剧中每一段故事，都对应一道人生滋味，展现爱情的甜亲情的苦背叛的辣梦想的酸与欲望的咸，融合台湾人饮食文化与庶民记忆，勾勒出在生命里最熟悉的味道与情感，透过时代转变与两代间的冲突，诉说成长与和解的历程，是一部结合文化深度与情感张力的戏剧Bittersweet Destiny is a Taiwanese original series that uses cuisine as the connecting thread to weave together themes of emotion, human nature, and Taiwanese culture. The story is sparked by a frame-up incident involving a master chef, which causes his daughter and five apprentices to ...

programme.title: 阿松与阿暖Our Town, Her Time
programme.desc: 台湾小镇纸艺师阿松性格固执，与家人关系紧张，人生陷入了停滞某天，来自明朝的神秘女子阿暖突然出现成为他的徒弟，打破了他的平静生活一段相处后，两人发现彼此有跨越三百年的命运牵连在阿暖的影响下，阿松逐渐改变，学会面对情感与家庭，也与她产生了深刻连结故事融合了传统文化奇幻与成长，是一段关于改变与归属的温暖旅程Song, a stubborn paper artisan in a small town, leads a stagnant life until Nuan, a mysterious woman from the Ming Dynasty, appears as his apprentice. As they uncover a bond spanning 300 years, Song learns to embrace love, mend family ties, and discover where he truly belongs.

programme.title: 爱的荣耀Glory of Love
programme.desc: 一桩吸金诈骗案意外改变了三个女人的命运：有如大树般坚强的女性；如花般绽放的富家千金；也有如小草般的平凡女性借由三个女主角来传达自信勇气及自我价值的重要性，从爱出发能克服任何困境挖掘出无限潜能和力量！A money-driven fraud case unexpectedly alters the destinies of three women: a resilient woman resembling a sturdy tree, a wealthy daughter blossoming like a flower, and an ordinary woman akin to grass. These three heroines convey the message of self-worth, highlighting the importance of love in overcoming challenges and unlocking ones unlimited potential.

programme.title: NCIS: Origins S1
programme.desc: NCIS: Origins follows a young Leroy Jethro Gibbs in 1991, years prior to the events of NCIS. In the series, Gibbs starts his career as a newly minted special agent at the fledgling NCIS Camp Pendleton office where he forges his place on a gritty, ragtag team led by NCIS legend Mike Franks.

programme.title: Yes Captain!
programme.desc: The day of the simulation training draws nearer as the rookies continue to keep their distance from one another. A new chain of theft from the kitchen picks up pace after Shaiful is stripped of his CUA role. Kheng embarrasses himself while grappling with his jealousy over Dr Poon. Charlize, determined to get back with Joshua, reminisces about their relationship together.

programme.title: So Help Me Todd S2
programme.desc: Margaret and Todd team up to help a man who has been declared legally dead, even though he is very much alive.

programme.title: Wheel Of Fortune S43
programme.desc: Contestants spin the iconic Wheel, call out letters, and buy vowels to solve word puzzles for cash, luxury trips, and new cars. Hosted by Ryan Seacrest with Vanna White at the puzzle board.

programme.title: Beat Shazam USA S7
programme.desc: Jamie Foxx presents three teams with the challenge of recognising some hit songs by famous artists from around the world.

programme.title: Unbeatable
programme.desc: Some answers are good, but only one is UNBEATABLE in this knock-out quiz tournament where contestants could win up to 10,000.

programme.title: Weather Gone Viral S8
programme.desc: From whirling tornadoes to torrential rains, to harrowing hurricanes, Weather Gone Viral gives viewers unprecedented access to some of the most insane meteorological moments from around the world. Featuring videos of the most extreme and destructive weather conditions, firsthand accounts, and professional meteorologists sharing tales from the front lines, viewers get to experience the fury of Mother Nature.

programme.title: The Frugal Foodie
programme.desc: As a passionate home cook and bestselling author, Steph has a knack for turning everyday ingredients into extraordinary dishes proving that great food doesnt need to break the bank. Her approachable style, practical tips, and creative recipes have inspired millions to get into the kitchen and make cooking fun, easy, and accessible.

programme.title: Cooking Up A Fortune
programme.desc: Brand new series where the UKs most passionate cooks get a once-in-a-lifetime chance to launch their own food brand to the British public. Cooking Up a Fortune sees amateur foodies, who dream of escaping the rat race and cooking for a living, create and sell their dishes to hundreds of real diners in a purpose-built food arena. Each week the winning kitchen gets to launch their idea for a food business to paying customers in one of Europes busiest food markets.

programme.title: Alleys: Off The Beaten Tracks
programme.desc: Busan is the second largest city in Korea and a rapidly growing economic hub. As we explore the idyllic beaches of the Haeundae, we will also learn about Busans important - and sometimes tragic - place in Korean history.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! Duel Monsters
programme.desc: Yu-Gi-Oh! follows the adventures of high school student Yugi, who has a magical secret that comes to life when he plays his favorite card game.

programme.title: Ben 10 S1

Risa admitted to being the owner of the laundry shop and the daughter of a wealthy family, while Aldo claimed to be the owner of a duck farm. From that moment on, Risa and Aldo became close. They fell in love with each other. They became serious and planned to introduce their parents to each other. The situation became complicated when it was revealed that the parents introduced by Ris...

programme.title: Cinta Dua Pilihan
programme.desc: Fathir and Sukma are a simple yet happily married couple. Their happiness is tested when their child, Zahra, is diagnosed with a serious illness amidst their financial struggles. At the same time, Fathir unexpectedly runs into his ex-girlfriend, Clara, whose presence changes everything.

programme.title: 金手指The Goldfinger

programme.title: 天堂旅行团Always Have Always Will
programme.desc: 失意的青年与乐观活泼的小女孩意外相遇，共同开启了一段疗愈心灵的未知旅程两人在人生的起落中患难与共，用彼此的陪伴缝合生命的伤口在这段笑泪交织的征途中，他们不仅寻获了生存的勇气，更在黑暗的人生尽头，为彼此点燃了希望的微光

programme.title: 西游记之孙悟空三打白骨精The Monkey King 2
programme.desc: 孙悟空受命于观音娘娘，护送唐僧取西经途中遇到性感美艶兼法力高强的白骨精，要吃下洁净躯体的唐僧以求长生不老孙悟空为保护唐僧，将与白骨精展开连场激战！

programme.title: 红毯先生The Movie Emperor
programme.desc: 刘伟驰是一位渴望赢得电影奖项的香港天王巨星他与导演林浩合作拍摄以中国农村为题材的影片，希望在国际电影节能赢得荣誉于是，刘伟驰为农夫的角色体验当地乡村生活，结果却是笑话连篇的一场闹剧

programme.title: 扎职 3The Unwavering Brotherhood
programme.desc: 社团最德高望重的老大的三位得力门生，阿华阿飞与国仔，在运送社团的一批资金时竟被人拦逃截劫，令社团老大登上龙头的位置一事蒙上阴霾阿华决定带罪立功，誓要捉拿歹徒然而，当阿华发现身边的阿飞和国仔竟与盗窃有关时，他陷入了江湖情义与兄弟情谊的两难境地

programme.title: 前任4: 英年早婚The Ex-Files 4: Marriage Plan

programme.title: 边缘行者Man on the Edge

programme.title: 秘密访客Home Sweet Home

programme.title: 长津湖之水门桥The Battle at Lake Changjin II

programme.title: L风暴L Storm

programme.title: 味尽缘Hungry Souls: From Hell With Love
programme.desc: 味尽缘讲述了一位年轻厨师和一名饿魂之间的凄美爱情故事此剧也是首部以中元节为主轴的故事，剧情结合跨东南亚文化的中元节与 1970 年的新加坡黑帮并融合了浪漫，戏剧和幻想的元素根据中国古代的信仰， 孤魂野鬼会在中元节（农历七月）鬼门开时回到人间，享用人们的供祭人们会供奉 食物饮料金钱不同形式的娱乐，以安抚这些鬼魂

programme.title: 大泼猴The Legends Of Monkey King
programme.desc: 天道变数，石妖提前三百年破石而出，生存堪忧的石妖踏上了寻仙之路他在求仙路上九死一生，幸得金丝雀舍命相救，石妖因此许下了复活金丝雀的诺言为了实现诺言，石妖一路拜师修行，其间与天真烂漫的风铃和孤傲高冷的杨岚分别暗生情愫，还卷入了众妖与天庭的对抗之中A mortal man accidentally time-travels to the past and becomes the Monkey King. Unwilling to accept his fate, he embarks on a journey that brings him to face gods and demons.

programme.title: 天地剑心Sword and Beloved
programme.desc: 王权富贵是王权弘业和东方淮竹的儿子，是王权世家实力最强者被家族作为道门兵人培养的王权富贵，生活没有自由，而清瞳本来是毒娘子安排到王权家打听情报的间谍，和王权富贵结识后，在富贵的帮助下恢复了自由同时王权富贵内心渴望自由憧憬天下大同的信念亦被逐渐点燃，经历万剑穿心，王权富贵带着清瞳离开王权山庄，走上了自己所悟之道Wang Quan Fu Gui is the son of Wang Quan Hong Ye and Dongfang Huai Zhu, and the most powerful member of the Wang Quan family. programme.title: 现在很美丽Its Beautiful Now
programme.desc: 此剧讲述在回避恋爱和结婚的时代，李家三兄弟为了占据家庭长辈们留给他们的公寓而寻找伴侣的故事李庆哲是李家的祖父和精神领袖，年纪轻轻就成了鳏夫 在他最低谷的时候，收养了旻昊 与庆哲一样，旻昊和妻子都寄望于他们三个长大成人的儿子，三个体面的年轻人，都有一份不错的工作 庆哲向他的孙子们提出了一个提议， 第一个结婚的人会得到一套公寓 贤才是三个男孩中的第二个，是一名律师 润才是一位在该地区享有盛誉的牙医 秀才一边在包裹服务公司工作，一边为公务员考试做准备 三兄弟谁先结婚？

programme.title: 型男大主厨Stylish Man
programme.desc: 台湾广受欢迎的常青美食料理节目，由2006年始播至今，2011年还获选金钟奖的最佳综合节目主持人奖每一期将有不同的主题：大明星來下廚由兩位明星或两个明星档分組對抗，拿出自己的拿手菜對抗比拼；五分钟出好菜由两位厨师根据指定食材，在五分钟内烹煮出易学美味的一道菜等这是一个富有娱乐效果的轻松美食节目，能够持续制作这么多年不是没有理由的

programme.title: 早餐中国第五季Breakfast In China S5
programme.desc: 早餐中国第5季，30种热气腾腾的早餐，30种人生况味我们依然在拍摄那些微不足道的民间食物，依然在见证那些触手可及的人间奇迹

programme.title: 两岸一味第一季第二季The Flavourful Link Across the Strait S1 S2
programme.desc: 以街头巷尾的民间味道为联结，追溯两岸美食的中华渊源，讲述两岸故事，共鸣情感与文化六大主题版块，30种两岸吃食，60组人文故事，用两岸一脉共生的食之味，展现两岸一根同源的人情味，讲述两岸饮食的人间烟火，追寻中华民族的味觉乡愁

programme.title: 正义女神Themis
programme.desc: 言惠知因一宗少年案放弃晋升高院机会，转任少年法庭裁判官，也因此与丈夫离婚她坚持不枉不纵，在惩罚与救赎之间守护公义，赢得法院上下敬重立志成为最年轻高院法官的郑邵文因她的到来仕途受阻面对连串少年罪案，两人在理念碰撞中，携手帮助迷途少年重返正轨After a life-changing juvenile crime case, Zhi leaves a fast-track High Court career for the Juvenile Court, costing her marriage. As she and ambitious magistrate Wen tackle difficult youth cases, they balance justice, compassion and redemption.

programme.title: 夏日奇妙书My Marvellous Fable
programme.desc: 实习编辑冯天蓝加入出版社的第一份任务就是去催畅销作家王葡萄的稿件，而她交稿的条件就是让冯天蓝从北京开车送她回老家琼海！在回乡的旅程中，王葡萄开始说一些真假参杂的故事，冯天蓝在整理书稿中拼凑出了王葡萄的人生，而王葡萄也在创作中反思自我两个心中有伤的人展开了互相治愈的浪漫奇幻之旅

programme.title: 爱情有烟火Love Has Fireworks
programme.desc: Qian Fei worries Li Yifei is bearing too much risk for her. Their domestic banter turns warmer, he realizes he likes her, and she starts teaching him how to live more frugally.

programme.title: 阿松与阿暖Our Town, Her Time
programme.desc: 台湾小镇纸艺师阿松性格固执，与家人关系紧张，人生陷入了停滞某天，来自明朝的神秘女子阿暖突然出现成为他的徒弟，打破了他的平静生活一段相处后，两人发现彼此有跨越三百年的命运牵连在阿暖的影响下，阿松逐渐改变，学会面对情感与家庭，也与她产生了深刻连结故事融合了传统文化奇幻与成长，是一段关于改变与归属的温暖旅程Song, a stubborn paper artisan in a small town, leads a stagnant life until Nuan, a mysterious woman from the Ming Dynasty, appears as his apprentice. As they uncover a bond spanning 300 years, Song learns to embrace love, mend family ties, and discover where he truly belongs.

programme.title: 百味人生Bittersweet Destiny
programme.desc: 百味人生是一部以料理为引线，交织情感人性与台湾文化的原创戏剧故事围绕一位总舖师因为一宗陷害事件，使其女儿与五位徒弟从分崩离析到彼此纠葛，呈现横跨25年的恩怨情仇与家族纠结剧中每一段故事，都对应一道人生滋味，展现爱情的甜亲情的苦背叛的辣梦想的酸与欲望的咸，融合台湾人饮食文化与庶民记忆，勾勒出在生命里最熟悉的味道与情感，透过时代转变与两代间的冲突，诉说成长与和解的历程，是一部结合文化深度与情感张力的戏剧Bittersweet Destiny is a Taiwanese original series that uses cuisine as the connecting thread to weave together themes of emotion, human nature, and Taiwanese culture. programme.title: Isteri Dalam Sangkar
programme.desc: Aisyah rebah di dalam hujan. Iskandar meminta Haziq untuk membiarkan Aisyah pengsan bersendirian tetapi sekali lagi Haziq memaksa Iskandar untuk bersikap perikemanusiaan. Iskandar mengalah dan mereka terpaksa membawa Aisyah ke homestay mereka untuk di rawat. Di homestay mereka buntu bagaimana untuk menguruskan Aisyah yang masih pengsan. Haziq meminta Iskandar menjaga Aisyah sementara dia pergi memanggil empunya homestay iaitu kak Wan. Belum sempat kak Wan dan Haziq tiba di homestay, orang kampung sudah tiba dahulu di homestay itu dan menangkap Iskandar dan Aisyah yang sedang berdua. Mak Su Ainin dan Fasha memarahi Farid kerana mahu merogol Aisyah. Takut diketahui orang ramai, Mak Su Ainin yang melihat kejadian Aisyah berlari keluar kerana hampir dirogol oleh Farid itu terus membuat perancangan mengenakan Aisyah bagi menutup malu. Mak Su Ainin dan Fasha dan ke homestay dengan berpura-pura sedih dan kecewa atas kelakuan Aisyah. Aisyah dan Iskandar menafikan mereka berkhalwat, penjelasan demi penjelasan di berikan namun tiada siapa yang percaya. Mak Su Ainin meminta Aisyah dan Iskandar berkahwin pada malam itu juga.

programme.title: Isteri Dalam Sangkar
programme.desc: Iskandar menolak sekerasnya untuk tidak berkahwin dengan Aisyah namun dia juga tidak berdaya apabila Farid datang dan mengugutnya. Aisyah juga tidak terkata, Aisyah tidak tahu dirinya telah di fitnah oleh Mak Su Ainin dan Fasha. Melihat Mak Su Ainin yang berpura pengsan akibat malu, Aisyah terpaksa redha. Dia redha berkahwin dengan seorang lelaki yang angkuh dan sombong dari hari pertama mereka berjumpa. Aisyah bukan sahaja dipaksa berkahwin tanpa rela, dia juga dihalau keluar oleh orang kampung dan Mak Su Ainin. Buntu dengan keadaan itu, Aisyah terpaksa akur dengan apa yang sedang berlaku dan pergi meninggalkan segala kenangan yang indah bersama arwah ibu dan bapanya. Sementara dalam kebencian, Iskandar terpaksa membawa Aisyah pulang ke sebuah kondo mewah milik Iskandar. Tengku Maria menerima khabar Iskandar sudah kembali, dia meminta Iskandar berjumpa dengannya dalam kadar segera jika mahu kekayaan yang sedang di milikinya kekal. Aisyah, terus di herdik dan diberi amaran keras oleh Iskandar untuk tinggal di dalam kondo mewah itu dan membuat segala perkerjaan seperti orang gaji.

programme.desc: Dulang Boy mengisahkan tentang seorang budak lelaki berusia 10 tahun bernama Kerol Lazania KL yang teruja kerana dipilih menjadi dulang boy untuk majlis perkahwinan kakaknya, Ros. Mereka cuba mencuci kasut itu, tetapi akhirnya kasut tersebut koyak pula. KL dan Yoyo kemudian berusaha sedaya upaya untuk membetulkan keadaan sebelum majlis bermula.

programme.title: Secebis Rindu
programme.desc: Reeza cuba cari sebab kenapa Rasya berubah tiba-tiba. Reeza nak jumpa keluarga Rasya. Reeza nak keluarga mereka kenal dengan siapa mereka berkawan. Reeza ajak Rasya jumpa mama Rasya dahulu. Rasya dalam dilema.

programme.title: Bisikan Pontianak
programme.desc: Selepas ditinggalkan suaminya, Suraya membesarkan dua orang anaknya sendirian di sebuah rumah terpencil. Namun apabila bekas suaminya kembali untuk menuntut tanah warisan, kejadian-kejadian aneh mula menghantui kampung mereka, memaksa keluarga itu berdepan dengan rahsia silam yang selama ini tersembunyi.

programme.title: J Retribusi
programme.desc: Jay, bekas ketua Unit Tindakan Khas UTK, kini menjadi pengawal keselamatan kepada Nadi, anak Dato Hashim. Ketika Dato Hashim terperangkap dalam rancangan penjenayah, Jay, bersama Chang dan Amy, berjuang menyelamatkan Nadi dari menjadi tebusan. Dengan keberanian, strategi, dan semangat keluarga, mereka menentang musuh yang licik, menghadapi cabaran demi cabaran demi memastikan keselamatan Nadi dan menebus masa lalu Jay.

programme.title: Black S1 EP2
programme.desc: Pegawai penguatkuasa undang-undang Bunian 444 atau juga dikenali sebagai Black sedang diburu kerana rakan setugasnya seorang penderhaka, 419, telah melarikan diri ke dunia manusia. Menyedari 419 telah menghuni tubuh manusia, Black memutuskan untuk memasuki tubuh Malik untuk bersaing dengannya. Pada mata manusia, Malik telah terselamat daripada kematian dengan menakjubkan sekali dan akibat kejadian itu dia telah hilang ingatan. Dalam pada itu, Sofia mula menyedari yang Malik merupakan buat hatinya semasa kecil dan dia diselubungi rasa bersalah kerana telah meletak Malik dalam situasi bahaya. Namun Malik sekarang ialah Black - biadab, mementingkan diri sendiri dan tekad dengan satu tujuan dalam misinya. Adakah dia akan ingat siapa Sofia sebenarnya? Black mendapati dirinya berdepan dengan pembunuhan yang mengerikan semasa dia cuba mengharungi dunia manusia. Keadaan menjadi lebih rumit apabila seorang lelaki yang penuh misteri muncul dan membayangi setiap gerak-gerinya.

programme.title: Fobia Malam Pertama
programme.desc: Fobia Malam Pertama menceritakan tentang Zaty, pelajar sebuah kolej tempatan di Pulau Pinang yang fobia untuk bercinta.

programme.title: Black S1 EP3
programme.desc: Black mula seronok berada dalam badan manusianya. Namun menghuni tubuh badan manusia ialah jenayah Kelas A dalam dunia Bunian - Black menerima kata dua - dia mesti dapat mencari 419 atau menerima hukuman yang paling menggerunkan. Meskipun begitu, satu lagi kes pembunuhan yang mengerikan telah berlaku, sama seperti kejadian baru-baru ini. Nampaknya mangsa seperti ada kaitan dengan Aisya. Lelaki dengan wajah berparut muncul untuk menyeksanya ... siapa dia dan kenapa Aisya mengikut arahannya? Sofia dapat tahu yang mungkin ayahnya telah dibunuh dan ini membawanya kepada CEO Insurans Mahkota, Lokman Nazir, yang boleh mendapatkan fail lama ayahnya ... dan mungkin menjadi petunjuk kepada identiti pembunuh ayahnya.

programme.title: Jiwa Taiko
programme.desc: Kesilapannya mungkin menyebabkan dia dipenjara, tetapi bagi Firman, ia juga menjadi pemangkin permulaan baru dalam hidup. Trisya seorang gadis yang mendambakan untuk dicintai, tetapi apabila bertemu dengannya barulah dia sedar bahawa cinta sejati bukanlah hamparan bunga mawar. Freez adalah seorang lelaki yang riang yang hanya berfikir tentang melepak dengan rakan-rakannya dan menjadi gembira, manakala Lara adalah seorang yang bersemangat bebas yang mahu membuat jalannya di dunia sendiri. Mereka berempat bertemu di Wira Cinta, sebuah kelab yang dimiliki oleh Kak Pora di mana mereka semua belajar seni mempertahankan diri dan juga mengenali diri mereka sendiri, apabila Pinto, abang ipar Firman dari masa lalunya yang kelam muncul di kelab itu dan menuntut bahawa Firman kembali kepada kumpulan itu atau menghadapi akibatnya.

programme.title: Misteri Wan Peah EP11
programme.desc: Cikgu Zaiton pengsan selepas ternampak lembaga seakan-akan Wan Peah di hadapan rumah Cikgu Siti semasa pulang dari kedai. Tok Hashim kemudiannya mengadakan sembahyang hajat dan doa selamat. Mak Timah dan Cikgu Zaiton tidak habis-habis menyalahkan Cikgu Siti yang kononnya memakai menyebabkan huru-hara di kampung mereka. Selepas solat hajat, Nurin yang merasa bersalah mengaku dialah yang menakut-nakutkan Cikgu Zaiton pada malam tersebut. Farhan semasa berkelah dengan Cikgu Siti dan 3 sahabatnya di Bukit Berapit mendapati Aishah tiba-tiba hilang.

programme.title: The Equalizer S1
programme.desc: Mel menyamar sebagai sukarelawan untuk seorang ahli politik yang semakin meningkat naik ketika McCall cuba membantu seorang pelajar kolej yang tertekan selepas diancam oleh seseorang dari dalam kempen calon tersebut. Selain itu, McCall mula risau apabila Delilah berkawan dengan seorang gadis muda yang pernah dipenjarakan di pusat tahanan juvana, mengingatkannya kepada masa silamnya yang penuh masalah.

programme.title: The Lift
programme.desc: Selepas sahabat baiknya hilang, seorang gadis kolej yang menghidap klaustrofobia mula menyiasat lif misteri tempat rakannya kali terakhir dilihat lif yang mungkin merupakan pintu ke dunia gelap yang menakutkan.

programme.title: Interchange
programme.desc: Dihantui oleh penglihatan yang suram, jurugambar forensik Adam berundur dari dunia, tinggal di rumah dan mengambil gambar jirannya sehingga dia diseret ke dalam penyiasatan lain oleh kawan baiknya, Detektif Man, yang meminta bantuannya untuk menyelesaikan siri pembunuhan ritual yang mengerikan. Pada masa yang sama, hobi Adam yang kelihatan tidak berbahaya tidak lama kemudian menjadi lebih gelap apabila dia mengintip Iva, seorang wanita muda dari Borneo. Terpesona olehnya, dia tidak lama lagi terjerat dalam rangkaian misteri dan pembunuhannya. Ketika Adam diseret lebih jauh ke dalam dunia puak Iva dan Man menyelidiki penyiasatannya dengan lebih mendalam, mereka menemui mistik bawah tanah bomoh dan makhluk ghaib di bandar itu.

programme.title: Saranjana Kota Ghaib
programme.desc: Apabila Sitha, penyanyi utama kumpulan terkenal hilang, kumpulan itu meneruskan pencarian, mengetahui bahawa Sitha berada di Saranjana, sebuah bandar ghaib, dan untuk membawanya kembali, mereka mesti mencari portal melalui pengembaraan peristiwa mistik.

programme.title: Bisikan Pontianak
programme.desc: Selepas ditinggalkan suaminya, Suraya membesarkan dua orang anaknya sendirian di sebuah rumah terpencil. Namun apabila bekas suaminya kembali untuk menuntut tanah warisan, kejadian-kejadian aneh mula menghantui kampung mereka, memaksa keluarga itu berdepan dengan rahsia silam yang selama ini tersembunyi.

programme.title: Black S1 EP2
programme.desc: Pegawai penguatkuasa undang-undang Bunian 444 atau juga dikenali sebagai Black sedang diburu kerana rakan setugasnya seorang penderhaka, 419, telah melarikan diri ke dunia manusia. Menyedari 419 telah menghuni tubuh manusia, Black memutuskan untuk memasuki tubuh Malik untuk bersaing dengannya. Pada mata manusia, Malik telah terselamat daripada kematian dengan menakjubkan sekali dan akibat kejadian itu dia telah hilang ingatan. Dalam pada itu, Sofia mula menyedari yang Malik merupakan buat hatinya semasa kecil dan dia diselubungi rasa bersalah kerana telah meletak Malik dalam situasi bahaya. Namun Malik sekarang ialah Black - biadab, mementingkan diri sendiri dan tekad dengan satu tujuan dalam misinya. Adakah dia akan ingat siapa Sofia sebenarnya? Black mendapati dirinya berdepan dengan pembunuhan yang mengerikan semasa dia cuba mengharungi dunia manusia. Keadaan menjadi lebih rumit apabila seorang lelaki yang penuh misteri muncul dan membayangi setiap gerak-gerinya.

programme.title: Black S1 EP3
programme.desc: Black mula seronok berada dalam badan manusianya. Namun menghuni tubuh badan manusia ialah jenayah Kelas A dalam dunia Bunian - Black menerima kata dua - dia mesti dapat mencari 419 atau menerima hukuman yang paling menggerunkan. Meskipun begitu, satu lagi kes pembunuhan yang mengerikan telah berlaku, sama seperti kejadian baru-baru ini. Nampaknya mangsa seperti ada kaitan dengan Aisya. Lelaki dengan wajah berparut muncul untuk menyeksanya ... siapa dia dan kenapa Aisya mengikut arahannya? Sofia dapat tahu yang mungkin ayahnya telah dibunuh dan ini membawanya kepada CEO Insurans Mahkota, Lokman Nazir, yang boleh mendapatkan fail lama ayahnya ... dan mungkin menjadi petunjuk kepada identiti pembunuh ayahnya.

programme.title: Unhuman
programme.desc: Semasa keluar berkhemah, San dan rakan-rakannya dari sekolah menengah merakam gambar meteor yang terhempas. Gambar itu mengandungi petunjuk kematian seorang saintis yang menjalankan kerja eksperimen dengan organ manusia dan kemungkinan kaitan dengan ahli sihir Kemboja.

programme.title: Highland Tower
programme.desc: Pada Disember 1993, sebuah blok kondominium mewah runtuh selepas hakisan tanah dari lereng bukit bersebelahan. Kira-kira 50 orang terkorban dan kejadian ini sehingga kini menjadi salah satu tragedi paling gelap dan menyedihkan dalam sejarah Malaysia. Dua puluh tahun kemudian, pada 2013, sekumpulan pembuat filem dokumentari menjelajah ke dua blok yang masih berdiri untuk menjalankan ekspedisi memburu hantu. Apa yang mereka temui tidak sesuai untuk mereka yang lemah semangat.

programme.title: Podcast Jejak Merdeka

programme.title: Leftenan Adnan
programme.desc: Adnan memutuskan untuk menjadi seorang tentera dalam pasukan Askar Melayu setelah dikunjungi anggota tentera British yang datang ke kampungnya untuk merekrut lebih ramai anak tempatan. Tidak direstui keluarga, Adnan nekad untuk mengikuti latihan ketenteraan di Port Dickson. Perjuangan Leftenan Adnan dalam mempertahankan Tanah Melayu memberikan inspirasi kepada ramai anak muda tempatan.

programme.title: Usop Wilcha Mehghonjang Makhluk Muzium
programme.desc: Mengisahkan sebuah muzium yang ingin mengadakan satu pameran Hantu-Hantu Dunia untuk menarik minat pengunjung. Tanpa disedari, penganjuran pameran ini mempunyai matlamat tersendiri. Melalui perancangan licik sekumpulan pengamal ilmu hitam dari Romania, pameran ini sebenarnya ingin menghidupkan kembali Raja Dracula. Mengikut kepercayaan kumpulan ini, Raja Dracula akan dapat hidup kembali dengan mendapatkan darah manusia dari setiap benua.

programme.title: Tipu Kanan Tipu Kiri
programme.desc: Rudy, seorang jejaka tampan yang memiliki segalanya, Isterinya bernama Wulan, seorang penyanyi terkenal di Indonesia. Malangnya dalam syarat kontrak rakamannya, Wulan tidak dibenarkan untuk berkahwin. Untuk menyembunyikan perkahwinan mereka, Rudy dan Wulan berpindah ke Malaysia. Pelbagai kejadian lucu berlaku akibat kekeliruan dan suasana kelam kabut yang terjadi akibat penipuan mereka berdua.

programme.title: Anak Sarawak
programme.desc: Pegawai Daerah, Azam Wasli berusaha untuk membangunkan Laka, sebuah kawasan terpencil di Sarawak. Pelbagai rintangan dihadapinya yang ingin menyatukan puak di kawasan itu. Azam turut menemui cinta bersama Mei Ling, seorang wartawan - tetapi dia diambil sebagai tebusan untuk menggugat posisi Azam. Insiden itu membawa kepada perjumpaan semula antara dua saudara.

programme.title: Darah Satria
programme.desc: Berpangkat Leftenan Muda, Ariff terlibat dalam operasi memburu komunis di hutan. Mempunyai seorang isteri bernama Rafidah, namun terpaksa ditinggalkannya bersama ibu bapanya kerana sibuk menjalankan operasi. Dalam satu operasi menentang komunis, Ariff bersama anak buahnya melalui kesukaran yang menyebabkan Ariff mengalami kecederaan manakala salah seorang daripada mereka terkorban.

programme.title: Leftenan Adnan
programme.desc: Adnan memutuskan untuk menjadi seorang tentera dalam pasukan Askar Melayu setelah dikunjungi anggota tentera British yang datang ke kampungnya untuk merekrut lebih ramai anak tempatan. Tidak direstui keluarga, Adnan nekad untuk mengikuti latihan ketenteraan di Port Dickson. Perjuangan Leftenan Adnan dalam mempertahankan Tanah Melayu memberikan inspirasi kepada ramai anak muda tempatan.

programme.title: Aku Ada Kau Ada ???
programme.desc: Seorang pelajar bernama Nordin Ahmad yang ingin kelihatan cool di mata orang lain. Walau bagaimanapun, setiap kali Nordin menjadi tumpuan, dia akan menjadi panik dan muntah. Sementara itu, Aziz pula seorang pelajar yang perasan popular yang selalu menyakat Nordin. Tina pula seorang pelajar yang baru bertukar ke kolej mereka untuk menjalani sebuah program khas untuk mengatasi sikap panas baran yang ditawarkan oleh Dr. Zida.

programme.title: Jiran
programme.desc: Mengisahkan Ramlan sekeluarga yang baru berpindah di sebuah kawasan perumahan. Namun, Ramlan melarang isteri dan anaknya Tina daripada bergaul dengan jiran-jiran mereka di situ. Ramlan sendiri beranggapan bahawa dengan berlaku sombong terhadap orang, dirinya akan dipandang mulia. Kesombongan Ramlan itu akhirnya menyusahkan dirinya sendiri apabila berlaku satu insiden yang melibatkan kehilangan Tina.

programme.title: Estet
programme.desc: Mengisahkan para pekerja estet Cinta Manis yang bakal bertarung dengan kumpulan estet Red Cobra dalam satu perlawanan bola sepak yang sudah 20 tahun tidak diadakan. Farid dan Shashi, dua pekerja estet yang berkawan sejak kecil, menjadi harapan pekerja estet yang lain untuk menyelamatkan penindasan yang dilakukan oleh kerani estet, Pooniah. Seorang gadis cantik bernama Geetha tertarik hati dengan Farid dan Shashi. Sesi latihan dikendalikan oleh Subramaniam iaitu bapa Geetha yang dilantik sebagai jurulatih. Ayah kepada Shashi, Apaa, adalah pemain bola yang sangat mahir, tetapi telah berlaku insiden semasa perlawanan bola sepak estet itu dahulu yang mana kakinya patah diterjah oleh Junna, seorang samseng estet yang sengaja ingin menamatkan karier Apaa atas upahan Pooniah 20 tahun yang lalu. Berjayakah Farid dan Shashi serta kawan-kawannya membebaskan pekerja estet Cinta Manis daripada penindasan Pooniah?

programme.title: Tuah
programme.desc: Datuk Shaari dan Shahira diselamatkan oleh seorang lelaki yang mendakwa bahawa dirinya Hang Tuah, seorang pahlawan Melayu di abad ke-15. Meragui kisahnya, mereka membawanya melakukan pemeriksaan fizikal dan mental di hospital, lama-kelamaan Shahira mula mempercayainya. Tuah secara ajaibnya telah dibawa ke zaman moden dan mula mempelajari apa yang terjadi pada masa lalu. Akhirnya, Tuah pulang semula ke tempat asalnya dan mula membetulkan keadaan.

programme.title: Pecah
programme.desc: Empat orang lelaki berjaya merompak sebuah bank tetapi malangnya salah seorang daripada mereka cedera dan terpaksa dirawat di hospital. Pada masa yang sama, seorang wanita yang menjaga orang tua di sebuah rumah orang tua, membawa salah seorang penghuninya ke hospital yang sama untuk mendapatkan rawatan. Apa yang berlaku kemudiannya ialah pembongkaran demi pembongkaran agenda tersembunyi, di samping penyiasatan daripada pihak polis pada masa yang sama.
